Ka an-anayan ne sulat ni Pablu te

The first letter by Paul to

Matig-Kurintu

The (ones) from_Kurintu

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka an-anayan ne sulat ni Pablu te Matig-Kurintu, insulat din te timpu ne diye sikandin te Ipisu ka egwali. Insulat din seini eyew te pegbulig te me prublima ne nabayaan te nalein-lein ne punduk te migmalintutuu ne impes-ek din diye te Kurintu. Ka Kurintu ka iney ne siyudad te prubinsya te Akaya, ne ka Akaya, sabeka te prubinsya ne sakup te Ruma. Te seeye ne timpu, sabeka ne dakel ne siyudad ka Kurintu ne nangugpaan te me Grigu, Rumanhen, wey me Hudiyu. Ne puun su ilis sika te dahat, masalig degma ka egmangendiye ne eg-untud te me barku ka egpamelegye wey egpameli. Nabantug ka sika ne siyudad tenged te karatu din, wey masalig ka nalein-lein ne rilihiyun te mahinged dutu, wey masalig degma ka egmeyibhilabetey dutu wey ka eg-ikul te tapey ne batasan ne iling due. Hapit migdaruwa ne leg-un si Pablu ka mig-ugpe diye eyew te pegwali, wey masalig ka migpalintutuu (Me Himu 18).

The first letter by Paul (MS Pablu) to The (ones) from_Kurintu, he wrote at the time that he was there preaching in Ipisu. He wrote this in_order for helping with the problems that the churches that he planted (LIT drove_into_ground) there in Kurintu went_through. Kurintu is the capital (LIT mother) city of the province of Akaya, and Akaya, is one of the province(s) that is under_the_jurisdiction of Ruma. At that time, Kurintu was one big city that Grigus, Rumanhon, and Hudiyus (MS Hudiyu(s)) lived_in(pl). And since it is on the edge of the sea, many (people) also go_there(pl) that rode on ships to sell(pl) and buy(pl). That city became famous due to its wealth, and there were many various religions of the local(s) there, and also many committing_adultery_with_each_other there and (those) following/imitating the former custom(s) like that. Paul almost reached_two years living there in_order for preaching, and many believed (Acts 18).

Peglihad te me tatelu ne leg-un, taheed te diye si Pablu te Ipisu ka egwali, nakarawat sikandin te sulat puun te migmalintutuu diye te Kurintu (1 Kur. 7:1). Nakarineg man-e sikandin meyitenged te ehetanan te migmalintutuu wey te duma pad ne me prublima ran diye te punduk te migmalintutuu. Te seini ne sulat, intambahan din sikandan meyitenged due wey egpepaaween din seeye se egmeyibhilabetey ne sakup te punduk dan te migmalintutuu. Intabak din man-e seeye se me inse meyitenged te egmaas-asaweey, me balu, me dasag te Panisingan te Manama, wey ka peg-uyag te me minatey.

After the passing of three years, while Paul was still preaching in Ephesus, he received a letter from the church there in Kurintu (1 Cor. 7:1). He also heard about the argument of the believers and about their other problems there in the group of believers. In this letter, he advised them about that and he causes_ those who are committing_adultery_with_each_other who are members of their church _to_be_removed. He also answered those questions about marrying_each_other, widows, gifts of the Spirit of God (MS Manama), and the bringing_alive of the dead.

Te kapitulu 13, nahuhud due ne sika se geyinawa, iyan sika ka subla ne meupiya ne dasag te Manama diye te keet-etawan din. Ne kema ke sika iya ka amana ipanengneng te seini ne baseen.

In chapter 13, it's told there that that love, (it) is the greatest gift from God to his people. And perhaps that is what is greatly made_known by this document.

11 Sikeddiey si Pablu ka migpeuyan te seini ne sulat duma te suled ta ne si Sustinis. In-alam a ne egkeyimu ne apustulis ni Kristu Hisus sumale te pegbuut te Manama.

11 I am Paul sending this letter along_with our(incl) friend/sibling Sustinis. I was_chosen to become an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the will of God.

2 [xr]Egpangemusta key kaniyu te migmalintutuu te Manama due te Kurintu ne immatulus din pinaahi te pegsabeka rin kaniyu ki Kristu Hisus. In-alam kew te Manama ne egkeyimu ne keet-etawan din duma te seeye se langun ne diye te nalein-lein ne inged ne egpangananey te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu. Sikandin ka Magbebaye ta langun.

2 [xr]We(excl) greet you(pl) the believers of God there in Kurintu that he made_holy by_means of his uniting you(pl) with Christ Jesus (MS Kristu Hisus). You(pl) were_chosen by God to become his people along_with all those in various places who call_for_help to our(incl) Lord (MS Magbebaye) Jesus Christ. He (is) the Lord of us(incl) all.

3 Ka keyid-u wey keupianan ne egpuun te Manama ne Amey ta wey te Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, egkaangken niyu.

3 The mercy and peace/well-being from God our(incl) Father and the Lord Jesus Christ, be received by you(pl).

Ka pegpasalamat ni Pablu diye te Manama

The thanking of God by Paul

4 Egpasalamat a layun te Manama meyitenged kaniyu tenged te keupiya wey keyid-u ne impapitew rin kaniyu puun te pegsabeka rin kaniyu ki Kristu Hisus. 5 Su tenged te pegsabeka rin kaniyu ki Kristu, impanalanginan kew te langun-langun de iya—te peglalag-lalag niyu wey te katuenan niyu. 6 Ne nakapamalehet seini ne malehet iya ka impanulu ney kaniyu meyitenged ki Kristu. 7 Sikan naa, ware kew nakulangi te nalein-lein ne katuenan ne imbehey te Panisingan te Manama kaniyu te pegtetahad niyu te peglibed te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu. 8 Eglig-enen din ka pegpalintutuu niyu taman te katamanan, su eyew ware igkarew-ey kaniyu te aldew te peglibed te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu. 9 Matinumanen ka Manama ne mig-alam kaniyu ne egpekegduma te Anak din ne si Hisu Kristu ne Magbebaye ta.

4 I always thank God for you(pl) due to the goodness and mercy that he showed you(pl) from his uniting you(pl) with Christ Jesus. 5 Because due to his uniting you(pl) with Christ, you(pl) were blessed with everything indeed—in your(pl) talking and in your(pl) knowledge/skill(s). 6 And this confirms that what we(excl) taught you(pl) about Christ is indeed true. 7 And so, you(pl) aren't lacking in various knowledge/skill(s) which were_given to you(pl) by the Spirit of God during your(pl) waiting for the returning of our(incl) Lord Jesus Christ. 8 He will_strengthen your(pl) believing/faith until the end, so_that there_will_be_nothing to scold_ you(pl) _for in the day of the returning of our(incl) Lord Jesus Christ. 9 God who chose you(pl) to walk_together with his Child our(incl) Lord Jesus Christ is faithful.

Ka pegkabaad-baad te migmalintutuu

The dividing of the believers

10 Me suled, egbanasalan ku sikaniyu pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu, te keilangan ne egpekeg-uyun kew langun su eyew kene kew egkabaad-baad. Keilangan ne sabekaa niyu ka suman-suman niyu wey ka katuyuan niyu. 11 Me suled ku, nahuhuran a te sakup ni Klui ne egmaap-apuley kew kun. 12 [xr]Ka duma kaniyu ne egkahi kun, “Eg-ikul a ki Pablu”, wey egkahi ka duma, “Eg-ikul a ki Apulus”, ne ka duma, “Eg-ikul a ki Pidru[fn]”, wey egkahi ka duma, “Eg-ikul a ki Kristu.” 13 Mania, nabaad-baad si Kristu? Kahiyen niyu buwa ne sikeddi, si Pablu, ka migpalansang para kaniyu? Mania, imbewutismuwan kew te ngaran ni Pablu?

10 Friends/cousins, I encourage you(pl) by_means of the name of our(incl) Lord Jesus Christ, that you(pl) all agree_together so_that you(pl) won't be divided. You(pl) need to unite your(pl) thinking and your(pl) purpose. 11 Friends/cousins, I have_been_told by Klui's followers that you(pl) argue_with_each_other. 12 [xr]What I mean is that some of you(pl) (reportedly)say, “I follow Paul”, and some say, “I follow Apulu”, and others, “I follow Pidru[fn]”, and others say, “I follow Christ.” 13 Why, is Christ divided? Maybe you(pl) think/say that I, Paul, was the (one) caused_to_be_nailed for you(pl)? Why, were you(pl) baptized in the name of Paul?

14 [xra][xrb]Amana a migpasalamat te wara a nakabewutismu kaniyu angin e ki Krispu wey ki Gayu, 15 purisu ware minsan sabeka ne egpakakahi ne pinaahi te ngaran ku ne nabewutismuwan kew. 16 [xr](E, uya bes, nabewutismuwan ku bes degma si Istipanas duma te pamilya rin, ne gawas kandan, warad e egkasuman-suman ku ne nabewutismuwan ku.) 17 Su wara a ipeuyan ni Kristu eyew egpamewutismu, ke kene, eyew te pegwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen. Ne wara a miggamit te me mateles ne me lalag te pegpapitew te katuenan ku, su kema ke egkaawaan e te geem ka pegpanulu meyitenged te kamatayen ni Kristu diye te krus.

14 [xra][xrb]I greatly thank that I didn't baptize you(pl) except for Krispu and Gayu, 15 therefore there_is_not even one who is able_to_say that by_means of my name you(pl) were baptized. 16 [xr](O, yes that's_right, I also baptized Istipanas along_with his family, and except them, I don't remember (anyone else) who I baptized.) 17 Because I wasn't sent by Christ in_order_to baptize, but rather, for preaching the Good Report. And I didn't use beautiful words for showing my skills/knowledge, because what if the teaching concerning the death of Christ on the cross would_be_removed of power.

Si Kristu ka geem wey kaalam te Manama

Christ is the wisdom of God

18 Su ka guhuren meyitenged te kamatayen ni Kristu diye te krus, keungelan de para te seeye se egmekeendiyad e te karereetan. Piru sikanta se nenaluwas, in-ila ta mule sika ne geem te Manama. 19 [xr]Su nasulat e te Kasulatan,

18 Because the story about the death of Christ on the cross, is just foolishness for those who are_going(pl) to destruction. But we(incl) who are_saved(pl), we(incl) recognize on_the_contrary that it's the power of God. 19 [xr]Because it's written in the Writings,

“Egdereetan ku ka kaalam te me matagseb,

“I will_destroy the wisdom of the brainy,

wey igsawile ku ka katuenan te me utekan.”

and I will_throw_(away) the skills/knowledge of the brainy (ones).”

20 [xra][xrb]Purisu, nekey naan e ka neyitabu te matagseb, te talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama, wey te meupiya ne talag-apul te seini ne timpu? Impakita iya te Manama ne keungelan de ka kaalam te seini ne kalibutan.

20 [xra][xrb]Therefore, what then happened to the wise (ones), to teacher(s) of the Law of God, and to good arguers of this time? God has revealed that the wisdom of this world is just foolishness.

21 Ne puun te kaalam te Manama, pegbuut din ne kene egpekeila kandin ka me etew te kalibutan pinaahi te kaalam dan mismu, tenged su planu rin ne egluwasen din seeye se egpalintutuu ki Kristu pinaahi te pegwali ta. Ne sika se inwali ta, in-isip te seeye se ware migpalintutuu ne keungelan kun de. 22 Su ka me Hudiyu, iyan dan egbuyuen ka me palinneu, ne ka me Grigu, iyan dan egpammitawen ka kaalam. 23 Piru sikanami mule, iyan ney inwali si Kristu, ka inlansang diye te krus. Ka sika ne wali, ingkeenendueni te me Hudiyu wey keungelan kun kahi te seeye se kene ne me Hudiyu. 24 Piru para te seeye se in-alam te Manama, me Hudiyu ma wey se kene, si Kristu ka geem wey kaalam te Manama. 25 Su ka in-isip dan ne keungelan kun ne hinimuwan te Manama, labew pad ne maalamen du te kaalam te etew. Ne minsan ka in-isip dan ne kahuye te Manama, subla pad ne makeseg du te kanekal te etew.

21 And from the wisdom of God, it's his will that the people of the world can't recognize him by_means of their own wisdom, because it's the plan of God that he will_save those who believe (in) Christ by_means of our(incl) preaching. And that which we(incl) preach, (it) is considered by those who don't believe as just foolishness. 22 Because the Hudiyus, what they request are signs, and Greeks, what they are looking_for is wisdom. 23 But we(excl) on_the_contrary, what we(excl) preached is Christ, the (one) nailed to the cross. That preaching, (it is) offensive to the Hudiyus and foolishness it_is_said by those (who are) not Hudiyus. 24 But for those chosen by God, Hudiyus or not, Christ is the power and the wisdom of God. 25 Because what they thought was the foolish actions of God, is more wise that the wisdom of people. And even (what) they thought was the weakness of God, is stronger that the strength of people.

26 Me suled, sumsumana niyu ke nekey kew dengan te peg-alam te Manama kaniyu. Salimbeka re kaniyu ka in-isip te duma ne matagseb, wey salimbeka re degma ka dakel se katungdanan, wey ka egpuun te talahuren ne pamilya. 27 Piru in-alam te Manama seeye se in-isip te me etew ne keungelan eyew te pegpeyilew te seeye se me matagseb. In-alam te Manama seeye se me etew ne in-isip ne ware me geem eyew te pegpeyilew te seeye se due me geem. 28 In-alam te Manama seeye se ware egkeyimu, ka egkaleig-leig de, wey ka in-isip te me etew ne ware pulus eyew te pegpapitew ne ware bes karuan te seeye se in-isip dan ne due karuan. 29 Ne puun due, ware egpakapeggasal diye te tangkaan te Manama. 30 Ka Manama ka migsabeka kaniyu diye ki Kristu Hisus, ne sikandin ka neyimu ne kaalam ta ne egpuun diye te Manama. Inggimu ki nikandin ne matareng, immatulus ki nikandin, wey inlekat ki nikandin puun te me sale ta. 31 [xr]Purisu, eg-ikul ki te nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Emun ke due egkeupian ne egpeggasal, keilangan ne sika se neyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama ka igpeggasal rin.”

26 Friends/cousins, think(pl) what you(pl) were before when God chose you(pl). Just a few of you(pl) are_considered by others to be wise, and just a few of you(pl) also have big responsibilities, and (are) from respected family(s). 27 But God chose those who are_considered by the people to be foolish for embarrassing/shaming those wise (ones). God chose those people considered powerless for embarrassing/shaming those with powers. 28 God chose those who have_no means (LIT IDIOM can't do), the (ones) just ridiculed, and the (ones) considered by the people as without purpose in_order to show that there_is_no purpose to those who consider that they do have purpose. 29 And from that, no (one) can_boast there in front of God. 30 God united you(pl) in Christ Jesus, and he became our(incl) wisdom from God. We(incl) were_made_righteous by him, we(incl) were_made_holy by him, and we(incl) were redeemed by him from our(incl) sin. 31 [xr]Therefore, we(incl) follow/imitate what is written in the Writings that go, “If there_is (someone) boasting, it's_necessary that what the Lord God_has_done is what he/she is boasting_about.”

Ka pegwali ni Pablu pinaahi te geem te Manama

The preaching of Paul by the power of God

21 Na, me suled, peggenduen ku te kaniyu, wara a miggendue ne miggamit te maddalem wey ke maalamen ne me lalag te pegpangguhud ku kaniyu meyitenged te heles ne kamalehetan puun te Manama. 2 Su nakaplanu ad te diye e pad te kaniyu ne ware lein ne igwali ku gawas de ki Hisu Kristu wey ka peglansang kandin diye te krus. 3 [xr]Miggenduen a te kaniyu ne mahuye, wey migpangelkel e pad te kaaldek. 4 Te pegwali ku due te kaniyu, wara a miggamit te mapahetpet ne me lalag eyew te pegpapitew te kaalam ku. Piru ka Panisingan te Manama ka migpamalehet ne malehet iya ka inwali ku. 5 Inggimu ku sika su eyew ka pegpalintutuu niyu, kene ne diye egpuun te kaalam te etew, ke kene, diye te geem te Manama.

21 Now_then, friends/cousins, my coming to you(pl), I didn't use deep or chosen words for my telling you(pl) about the hidden truth from God. 2 Because I planned while I was still with you(pl) that there_was_nothing else that_ I _would_preach except Jesus Christ and his nailing to the cross. 3 [xr]I went to you(pl) weak, and I was still shaking with fear. 4 In my preaching to you(pl), I didn't use enthusiastic words in_order for showing my wisdom. But the Spirit of God (is) the (one who) proved that my preaching was correct. 5 I did that so_that your(pl) faith/believing, would not be from the wisdom of people, but rather, the power of God.

Ka katagseb te Manama

The wisdom of God

6 Piru ke diye key te matesan e se pegpalintutuu, eggamit key te maalamen ne me lalag, piru kene ne iling te kaalam te seeye se kene egpalintutuu, wey te seeye se egmanlihad de ne me talagmandu te seini ne kalibutan. 7 Ka kaalam ne egkahiyen ney kayi, sika se neeles de ne kaalam te Manama ne ware din ipanengneng te me etew dengan. Te ware din pad himuwa ka kalibutan, tapey rin e planuwa sika eyew egpakalagkes ki degma te kabantug din keureme. 8 Ne ware minsan sabeka te talagmandu kayi te kalibutan ka nakasabut kayi, su emun ke nasabut pa nikandan, ware dan e perem ilansang ka Magbebaye ne likes te langun ne pegdayan. 9 [xr]Piru, sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue,

6 But if we(excl) are there with (those who are) mature in faith/believing, we(excl) use wise words, but not like the wisdom of those who don't believe, or those just passing_by rulers of this world. 7 The wisdom that we(excl) are_speaking about here, is that hidden wisdom of God that he didn't reveal to the people long_ago. Before he made the world, he had already planned that so_that we(incl) also can be included in his honor in_the_future. 8 And there_is_not even one ruler here in the world that understands this, because if they did understand it, they wouldn't have nailed the Lord who is worthy of all praise. 9 [xr]But, according to what is written in the Writings that go,

“Ware etew ne nakakita, nakarineg

“No person has seen, heard

wey nakasuman-suman

and thought

ke nekey iya ka in-andam te Manama para te seeye se miggeyinawa kandin.”

what indeed God has prepared for those who love him.”

10 Piru impanengneng sika kanta te Manama pinaahi te Panisingan din. Su ka Panisingan te Manama, eg-ugsi-ugsi te langun de iya, minsan pad ka maralem e ne suman-suman te Manama. 11 Ware minsan hentew ne nakataha ke nekey ka egsumsumanen te sabeka ne etew angin e te panisingan te sika ne etew mismu. Ne iling naan ded degma due, ware sabeka ne nakataha te suman-suman te Manama angin e te Panisingan din. 12 Piru meyitenged kanta, kene ne ka panisingan te kalibutan ka indawat ta, ke kene, sika se Panisingan te Manama ne impeuyan din eyew egpakasabut ki te langun ne imbehey te Manama kanta.

10 But God made_ that _known to us(incl) by_means of his Spirit. Because the Spirit of God, investigates everything indeed, even the deep thinking of God. 11 Not even one person knows what a person is thinking except the spirit of that person him/herself. And just like that also, no one knows the thinking of God except his Spirit. 12 But concerning us(incl), it's not the spirit of the world that we(incl) received, but rather, that Spirit of God that he sent so_that we(incl) would understand all that God has_given us(incl).

13 Purisu, te pegpanulu ta meyitenged te Manama, ware ta gamita ka me lalag ne egpuun te kaalam te etew, ke kene, ka me lalag ne impanulu kanta te Panisingan te Manama. Impasabut ney ka pegpanulu ne egpuun te Panisingan diye te me etew ne nakaangken te Panisingan te Manama. 14 Ka etew ne ware nakaangken te Panisingan te Manama, kene egdawat te langun de iya ne egpuun te Panisingan te Manama, su keungelan kun de kandin ka iling due. Ne kene man-e sikandin egpakasabut, tenged su egkasabut de ka iling due pinaahi te bulig te Panisingan te Manama. 15 Piru ka etew ne mig-ugpaan te Panisingan te Manama, egpakanengneng te langun ne egpuun te Panisingan te Manama, piru kene sikandin egkanengnengan te duma ne me etew. 16 [xr]Su sumale te Kasulatan,

We(excl) mean the teaching from the Spirit in people that have accepted the Spirit of God. 14 The person who didn't receive the Spirit of God, won't receive all that is indeed from the Spirit of God, because what things like that are just foolishness to him/her. And he/she also won't understand, because (things) like that can only be understood by_means of the help of the Spirit of God. 15 But the person who is lived_in by the Spirit of God, will_know all that is from the Spirit of God, but he/she won't be understood by other people. 16 [xr]Because according to the Writings,

But we(incl) believers (are) the (ones who) know what Christ is thinking.

Ka me suluhuanen te Manama

The servants of God

31 Me suled, dengan, kena a egpakapanulu kaniyu isip me etew ne mig-ugpaan te Panisingan te Manama, ke kene, isip me etew ne kalibutanen wey bate pad se pegpalintutuu ki Kristu. 2 [xr]Gatas de ka imbehey ku kaniyu, kene ne makehal ne keenen su kene kew pad nahud ne eleg ne egkeen due, wey minsan kuntee, kene kew pad man-e ne eleg 3 tenged su kalibutanen kew pad. Su puun te egmekeg-imma kew pad wey egmekeg-ehet, migpamalehet de iya sika ne kalibutanen kew. Ka hinimuwan niyu, iling te hinimuwan te me etew kayi te kalibutan. 4 [xr]Su emun ke egkahi ka sabeka, “Si Pablu ka eg-ikulen ku,” ne kahi te sabeka, “Si Apulus ka keddiey.” Nekeg-iling kew re iya te me etew kayi te kalibutan!

31 Friends/cousins, before, I couldn't teach you(pl) as people lived_in by the Spirit of God, but rather, as worldly people and still (like a) child in believing (in) Christ. 2 [xr]I just gave you(pl) milk, not hard food because you(pl) (were) not actually right to eat that, and even now, you(pl) are still not right yet 3 because you(pl) are still worldly. Because you(pl) are still envious and arguing_with_each_other, that indeed witnesses/proves that you(pl) are worldly. What_ you(pl) _have_done, is like what_ the people here in the world _have_done. 4 [xr]Because if one says, “Paul is the one_ I _follow,” and one says, “Apulus is mine.” You(pl) are just indeed like the people here in the world!

5 Hentew bes si Apulus? Hentew bes si Pablu? Me suluhuanen key re te Manama. Ne pinaahi kanami, nakapalintutuu kew, piru migtuman key re te impeyimu kanami te Magbebaye. 6 [xra][xrb]Sikeddiey ka migpamula, ne si Apulus ka migpamisbis, ne ka Manama ka migpatulin. 7 Purisu, kene ne impurtanti ke hentew ka migpamula wey ka migbisbis, su iyan impurtanti ka Manama ne migpatulin due. 8 Sika se migpamula wey ka migbisbis, nekeg-iling de ka katuyuan dan, wey egdasahan te Manama ka tagse sabeka sumale te hinimuwan din. 9 Su talagduma key te himu te Manama, ne sikaniyu ka kamet din.

5 Who [emphasis] is Apulus? Who [emphasis] is Paul? We(excl) are just servants of God. And by_means of us(excl), you(pl) have believed, but we(excl) were just obeying what_ the Lord _got_ us(excl) _to_do. 6 [xra][xrb]I (am) the one_who_plants, Apulus is the one_who_waters, and God is the one_who_causes_growth of it. 7 Therefore, it's not important who planted and who watered, because what's important is that it's God who_caused_ it _to_grow. 8 The (one who) planted and the (one who) watered, their purpose is the same, and each one is rewarded by God according to his action(s). 9 Because we(excl) are coworkers in the work of God, and you(pl) (are) his field.

Ne sikaniyu man-e ka baley rin.10 Sikeddiey ka egpekeiling te mangngateu ne talagbebaley ne migpes-ek te pabunsuran, tenged te katuenan ne imbehey te Manama keddiey. Due degma duma ne egpabulus ne egbebaley te impes-ek ku ne pabunsuran. Piru ka tagse sabeka, keilangan ne eg-ay-ayaran din ka himu rin. 11 Su warad e etew ne egpakabalew-balew te pabunsuran ne impakapabunsud e ne iyan si Hisu Kristu. 12 Due me etew ne eggamit te sika ne pabunsuran ne iyan eggamiten ka bulawan, pelata, wey tetelesi ne batu. Ne ka duma eggamit te kayu, lahami, wey hilamunen. 13 Piru ka hinimuwan te tagse sabeka, egkatahaan ded te Aldew te Peggukum tenged su eg-el-elehan sika pinaahi te hapuy eyew egkakita ke nekey ne klasi ne himu sika. 14 Ne emun ke kene egkatutung ka impasasindeg diye te pabunsuran, egpakarawat te dasag ka migpasasindeg due. 15 Piru ke due egkasilaban ne himu te sabeka ne etew, ware iya egkarawat din ne dasag. Piru egkaluwas ded sikandin, egpekeiling sikandin te etew ne nakapallahuy red puun te baley ne egkasilaban.

And you(pl) are also his house.10 I am_like a skilled builder who places the foundation, due to the knowledge/skill given to me by God. There are also others who continue to build on the foundation that I have driven_in. But each one, needs to take_care of his work. 11 Because no other person can_change/redo the foundation which has been_started which is Jesus Christ. 12 There are people who will_use that foundation and what (they) will_use is gold, silver, and beautiful stones. And others will_use wood, straw, and weed(s). 13 But the action(s) of each one, will_be_know in the Day of Judging because it will_be_tested by_means of fire so_that it will_be_seen what kind of work it is. 14 And if what_is_stood there on the foundation isn't burned, the one_who_stood it will_receive a gift/reward. 15 But if the work of a person is burned, he will_receive no gift/reward. But he will_ still _be_saved, he is like a person that was_able_to_run from a house that is burning.

16 [xr]Ware kew bes nakataha ne sikaniyu ka ugpaan[fn] te Manama wey due mig-ugpe te kaniyu ka Panisingan din? 17 Ke duen ma egdereet te ugpaan te Manama, egdereetan degma sikandin te Manama. Su matulus ka ugpaan te Manama, ne sikaniyu iya ka sika ne ugpaan.

16 [xr]You(pl) don't know [surprise] that you(pl) (are) the living_place[fn] of God and his Spirit lives there in you(pl)? 17 If there_is (one who) destroys the living_place of God, he will_be_also destroyed by God. Because the living_place of God is holy, and you(pl) indeed are that living_place.

18 Kene niyu limbungi ka pegkeetew niyu. Ke duen ma sabeka due te kaniyu ne egsuman-suman ne matagseb sikandin sumale te kalibutanen ne etew, meupiya pad ke eg-inniyuhan din ka sika ne kaalam su eyew egkeyimu iya sikandin ne malehet ne matagseb. 19 [xr]Su ka kaalam te seini ne kalibutan, keungelan de diye te tangkaan te Manama. Sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan, “Egsahiluten din seeye se egsuman-suman ne matagseb pinaahi red te kaalam dan.” 20 [xr]Ne duen pad man-e nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Nakataha ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne ware karuan te suman-suman te me matagseb.” 21 Purisu, keilangan ne kene kew egpeggasal meyitenged te senge-etew, su ka langun, imbehey e te Manama kaniyu. 22 Si Pablu, si Apulus, wey si Pidru, kaniyud iya. Minsan ka kalibutan, ka umul, ka kamatayen, ka kuntee, wey ka egginguma pad, kaniyu sika se langun. 23 Ne sikaniyu, kandin e ni Kristu, wey si Kristu, kandin e te Manama.

18 Don't(pl) cheat/deceive yourselves. If there_is one among you(pl) who thinks he is wise according to worldly people, it's better if he/she turns_(his)_back_on that wisdom so_that he/she can indeed become properly wise. 19 [xr]Because the wisdom of this world, is just foolishness there in front of God. According to what_is_written in the Writings, “He traps those (who) think they (are) wise by_means of their wisdom.” 20 [xr]And there_is also (something) written in the Writings that goes, “The Lord God knows that there_is_no value in the thinking of the wise.” 21 Therefore, it's_necessary that you(pl) don't boast about people, because everything, has been_given to you(pl) by God. 22 Paul, Apulus, and Pidru, are yours(pl) indeed. Even the world, life, death, today/now, and (what) is still coming, all that is yours(pl). 23 And you(pl), are Christ's, and Christ, is God's.

Ka me apustulis ni Hisu Kristu

The apostles of Jesus Christ

41 Purisu isipa key ne me suluhuanen ni Kristu ne insalihan te pegpangguhud meyitenged te heles ne kamalehetan puun te Manama. 2 Ne sika se insalihan, keilangan ne egpakita ne egkasalihan iya sikandin. 3 Sikeddi, ware amana karuan ke nekey ka ig-ugsi-ugsi niyu meyitenged keddi wey te minsan hentew. Su minsan sikeddi, kena a eg-ugsi-ugsi te himu ku. 4 Malinis ka kunsinsya ku, piru ware seini migpasabut ne warad iya sale ku. Ka Magbebaye de ka eggukum keddi. 5 Purisu kene kew ugsi-ugsi te minsan hentew te kene pad egginguma ka eleg ne timpu; tahari niyu taman ke eggingume e ka Magbebaye. Te sika ne timpu, igpanengneng din ke nekey ka neeles, wey igwangal-wangal rin ke nekey ka suman-suman te me etew. Te sika ne timpu, egpakarawat ka tagse sabeka te pegdeyrey te Manama sumale te hinimuwan din.

41 Therefore consider us(excl) servants of Christ that were entrusted for storying about the hidden truth from God. 2 And that (one) being_entrusted, it's_necessary that he/she's seen to be indeed trustworthy. 3 (For) me, there_is_no real purpose in you(pl) or anyone evaluating about me. Because even me, I don't evaluate my work. 4 My conscience is clean, but this doesn't mean that I have_no more sin. Just the Lord (is the one to) judge me. 5 Therefore don't evaluate anyone before the correct time comes; wait(pl) until the Lord comes. At that time, he will_make_known what is hidden, and he will_expose what is the thinking of the people. At that time, each one will_receive praising from God according to his action(s).

6 Me suled, te langun ne ingkahi ku, inggamit ku ne panunggilingan ka pegkeetew ku wey si Apulus eyew pinaahi kanami, egkapanulu kew ne egtuman ke nekey ka nasulat te Kasulatan. Emun ke egtumanen niyu sika, ware sabeka kaniyu ne egpakapeggasal ne eglapig te sabeka wey egdeeg-deeg te dangeb. 7 Hentew-a ka miggimu kaniyu ne labew te duma? Nekey-a ka due te kaniyu ne ware ibehey te Manama? Ne puun su diye te Manama egpuun ka langun ne due te kaniyu, mania te egpeggasal kew ne hendue ubag te kene ne dasag ka langun ne due te kaniyu!

6 Friends/cousins, in all that I said, I used myself for an example and Apulus so_that by_means_of us(excl), you(pl) would_be_taught to obey what_is_written in the Writings. If/when you(pl) obey that, no one of you(pl) can_boast that he favors one and shows_contempt for the other. 7 Who made you(pl) greater than other(s)? What do you(pl) have that wasn't given by God? And because everything you(pl) have is from God, why do you(pl) boast like everything you(pl) have it not a gift [embarrassedly]!

8 Kahiyen niyu ne duen e ka langun ne keilangan niyu! Kahiyen niyu ne me datu kew e te ispirituwanen! Kahiyen niyu ne mighari kew e, ne sikanami mule, ware pad! Meupiya iya perem ke eghari kew e su eyew egpakahari key e degma duma kaniyu! 9 Su sikanami se me apustulis, hendue te inggimu key te Manama ne kene ne impurtanti te langun ne etew. Nekeiling key te me pinirisu ne naparusaan te kamatayen, wey neyimu key ne tengtenganan te langun ne kayi te kalibutan: te me panalihan wey te me etew. 10 Kahiyen te me etew ne ungel key tenged te pegpalintutuu ney ki Kristu, ne sikaniyu mule, isip niyu ne matagseb kew tenged te pegpalintutuu niyu ki Kristu! Kahiyen man-e te me etew ne magguye key, ne sikaniyu, mannekal kew mule! Intahud kew te me etew, piru sikanami, ware mule tahura! 11 Minsan kuntee, egmanggutasan key, egkammaraan, ware amana kumbale ney, impanlampesan key, wey ware ugpaan ney. 12 [xr]Migpakannekal key miggimu para te keuyahan ney. Emun ke due egdeeg-deeg kanami, egpanalanginan ney sikandan; ke due egbayad-bayad kanami, eg-antusen ney seeye. 13 Ke eg-id-iranen key nikandan, meupiya mule ka igtabak ney. Ne minsan kuntee, in-isip key red te me etew ne iling te basuraan te kalibutan, wey ke museng te kendiru ne in-unasan.

8 You(pl) think_(wrongly) that you(pl) have all you(pl) need! You(pl) think_(wrongly) that you(pl) are spiritually rich! You(pl) think_(wrongly) that you(pl) reign already, and we(excl) other_the_contrary, not yet! It would_be good if you(pl) reign so_that we(excl) could_reign also with you(pl)! 9 Because us(excl) apostles, it's as if we(excl) were_made by God to be not important to all people. We(excl) were_like prisoners punished by death, and we(excl) became watched by all that is here in the world: by angels and by people. 10 People think_(wrongly) that we(excl) are foolish due to our(excl) believing (in) Christ, and you(pl) on_the_contrary, you(pl) think you(pl) (are) wise due to your(pl) believing (in) Christ! People also think_(wrongly) that we(excl) are weak, and you(pl), on_the_contrary you(pl) are strong/active! You(pl) are respected by the people, but we(excl), on_the_contrary are_ not _respected! 11 Even now, we(excl) are hungry(pl), thirsty, don't have many clothes, we(excl) have_been_beaten_(repeatedly), and we(excl) have_no living_place. 12 [xr]We(excl) strive to work for our(excl) living_needs. If/When there_is (someone who) oppresses us(excl), we(excl) bless them; if/when there_is (someone who) persecutes us(excl), we(excl) put_up_with it. 13 If we(excl) are slandered by them, what_ we(excl) _answer to_the_contrary is good. And even now/today, we(excl) are_considered by the people to be like the rubbish of the world, or charcoal that is scraped off a pot.

14 Kene ne insulat ku seini ne menu egpeyilawan kew, ke kene, pegpanulu seini kaniyu isip me pinalangge ku ne me anak. 15 Su minsan pad ke due libu-libu ne talagpanulu ne egpanulu kaniyu meyitenged ki Kristu, sabeka re ka amey niyu. Su tenged te pegpalintutuu niyu ki Kristu, neyimu a ne amey niyu pinaahi te pegpangguhud ku kaniyu te Meupiya ne Panugtulen. 16 [xr]Sikan naa, egbanasal a kaniyu ne eg-iling keddi. 17 Sika ka egpuunan ne igpeuyan ku due te kaniyu si Timutiyu, ka pinalangge wey matinumanen ne anak ku due te Magbebaye. Sikandin ka egpasuman-suman kaniyu ke immenu ku te peg-ugpe tenged te pegpalintutuu ku ki Kristu. Iling ded due ka impanulu ku diye te langun ne punduk te migmalintutuu ne neendiyaan ku.

14 The_reason_ I _write this is not (that) you(pl) be_ashamed, but rather, this is teaching you(pl) as my beloved children. 15 Because even if there were thousands of teachers who teach you(pl) about Christ, you(pl) only have one father. Because of your(pl) believing (in) Christ, I became your(pl) father by_means of my storying you(pl) with the Good Report. 16 [xr]So then, I encourage you(pl) to imitate me. 17 That's the reason that I will_send Timutiyu to you(pl), my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He (is) the (one who) will_remind you(pl) how I lived due to my believing (in) Christ. What_ I _taught to all of the groups of believers that I went to was_ just _like that.

18 Ka duma kaniyu, neyimu ne hambuhen, su kahiyen dan ne kena ad e egpekeendue te kaniyu. 19 Piru ke igtuhut te Magbebaye, eggenduen a te kaniyu te kene egkaluhey. Te sika ne timpu, egkatahaan kud ke duen naan iya geem te me hambuhen, su kema ke egpanlalag de due sikandan. 20 Su egkakita ne mighari e ka Manama kayi te kanta pinaahi te geem din ne egkakita kayi te kanta, ne kene ne pinaahi re te peglalag ta. 21 Na, hendei ka igkeupii niyu? Eggenduen a ka egparusa kaniyu, wey ke eg-ay-ayaran ku sikaniyu wey eggeyinawaan?

18 Some of you(pl), became proud, because they think_(wrongly) that I won't be_able_to_go_there to you(pl). 19 But if the Lord permits, I will_go_there to you(pl) before long. At that time, I will_know if there_is indeed power of the proud (ones), because what if they are just speaking_out. 20 Because it will_be_seen that God reigns in us(incl) by_means of his power that can be seen in us(incl), and not just by_means of our(incl) talking. 21 Now_then, which is your(pl) desire? I go_there to punish you(pl), or I treat_ you(pl) _carefully and love (you(pl))?

Ka pegpaawe te etew ne eggilabet te kene ne asawa rin

The removing of the person who meddles with (someone who is) not his/her spouse

51 [xr]Nahuhud e ne duen kun due te kaniyu ne eggimu te lilinditi ne hinimuwan, su duen kun etew ne mig-as-asawa te iney-iney rin. Ka iling due ne hinimuwan, ware de due neyimu te seeye se kene egpalintutuu te Manama. 2 Sikaniyu se me hambuhen! Emun naa perem su egkalaggew kew! Meupiya pad perem ke impaawe niyud e te punduk niyu ka eggimu te iling due. 3-4 Su minsan ke wara a due te kaniyu, piru iling ded te duen a.[fn] Ne pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisus, inggukuman kud e ka miggimu te iling due ne sale, iling te peggukum ku te duen e red. Purisu, diye te kalibulungan niyu, sumsumana niyu ne dume e red nikaniyu.[fn] 5 Keilangan ne igpiyal niyu ka sika ne etew diye ki Meibulan eyew egdereetan ka lawa rin, su eyew egkaluwas ded ka gimukud din te aldew te peglibed te Magbebaye.

51 [xr]I've been_told that there_is [reportedly] (someone) among you(pl) who does very dirty actions, because there_is [reportedly] a person who lives_in with his step-mother. Actions like that, just aren't even done by those who don't believe (in) God. 2 You(pl) who are proud! You(pl) should be sad! It would_be better if you(pl) sent out (the one who) does like that from your(pl) group. 3-4 Because even if I am not there with you(pl), but it's as if I (am) there.[fn] And by_means of the name of our(incl) Lord Jesus, I judged the (one who) does sin like that, like my judging when I (was) there. Therefore, in your(pl) meeting, think(pl) that I am just accompanying you(pl).[fn] 5 It's_necessary that you(pl) entrusted that person to Satan (MS Meibulan) so_that his body will_be_destroyed, so_that his soul will_be_saved on the day of the returning of the Lord.

6 [xr]Kene ne meupiya ka pegpaambug niyu! Ware kew nakanengneng te nakahi, “Minsan ke deisek ka igpatulin, egpakapatulin sika te inluyang ne harina”? 7 [xr]Ipaawe niyu due te kaniyu ka makasesale ne etew ne egpekeiling te igpatubu, eyew egkeyimu kew ne iyam. Emun ke eggimuwen niyu ka iling due, egpekeiling kew te iyam ne linuyang ne harina ne ware sewuhi te igpatulin. Ka malehet, iling kew en iya due su impakapanubad e si Kristu para kanta. Egpekeiling sikandin te karniru ne impanubad te timpu te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan. 8 [xr]Purisu, te pegsahakeen ta te Peglihad te Panalihan, kene ne iyan ta egkeenen ka paan ne due patulin, ne iyan sika se malindit ne himu wey mareet ne batasan. Su iyan ta egkeenen ka paan ne ware patulin, ne iyan sika se paan te kamalehetan wey ka kalinis te suman-suman.

6 [xr]Your(pl) being_proud is not good! Don't you(pl) know what is said, “Even a little rising_agent, can_rise that slurried flour”? 7 [xr]Cause(pl)_to_be_removed from (among) you(pl) the sinner person that is like rising_agent, so_that you(pl) will_become new. If you(pl) do like that, you(pl) will_become like newly slurried flour that is not mixed with rising_agent. The truth is, you(pl) are_like that because Christ sacrificed (himself) for us(incl). He is like a sheep that was sacrificed at the time of the Feast of the Passing of the Angel. 8 [xr]Therefore, at our(incl) feast for the Passing of the Angel, we(incl) don't eat bread with rising_agent, which is those dirty work(s) and bad customs. Because what we(incl) eat is bread without rising_agent, which is that bread of truth and clean thinking.

9 Diye te sulat ne impeuyan ku kaniyu, inlalahan ku sikaniyu ne kene eg-amung-amung te me etew ne egmeyibhilabetey se kene ne alunggun. 10 Piru kene ne iyan ku igpasabut seeye se kene egmalintutuu ne miggimu te keyilawan, me halamlamen, me limbungen, wey egmanimba te diyus-diyus. Ne emun ke egpanalliya kew te iling due ne me etew, keilangan ne eg-engkeran niyu ka seini ne kalibutan. 11 Ka impasabut ku diye te sulat ku, ne keilangan ne kene kew duma-ruma te seeye se mig-angken ne migpalintutuu, piru eggimu red te keyilawan, halamlamen ded, egsimba te diyus-diyus, talabayungen, talewubug, wey takawen. Kene kew duma kandan te egmangekeen.

9 There in the letter that I sent to you(pl), I told you(pl) to not participate with people who interfere_with_each_other who (are) not a couple. 10 But I don't mean those non believers who do embarrassing_(things), gluttonous (one)s, cheaters/deceivers, and (those who) worship(pl) false_god(s). And if you(pl) avoid people like that, it's_necessary that you(pl) leave_behind this world. 11 What_ I _meant in my letter, was that it's_necessary that you(pl) don't go_along_with those who say they believe, but do shaming (acts), are just greedy, worship false_god(s), are accuser(s), drunkard(s), and thief(s). Don't(pl) accompany them to eat.

12-13 [xr]Su ware labet ku ne eggukum te seeye se kene ne duma ta te pegpalintutuu, su kandin sika te Manama. Piru, duen iya mule katenged niyu te peggukum te seeye se sakup te punduk niyu te migpalintutuu, su due nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Ipaawe niyu due te kaniyu seeye se eggimu te mareet.”

12-13 [xr]Because I have_no business to judge those who are not our(incl) companions in believing, because that's God's (business). But, you(pl) do on_the_contrary have authority for judging those members of you(pl) group of believers, because there_is (something) written in the Writings that go, “Have_removed(pl) from (among) you(pl) those who do evil.”

Ka peggusey te ehetanan

The resolving_cases of conflict

61 Emun ke due sabeka kaniyu ne due igbennal te suled din te pegpalintutuu, mania te igpeyinguma rin pad diye te talaggukum ne kene egpalintutuu? Ka keet-etawan perem te Manama ka eggusey due. 2 Ware kew nakataha ne ka keet-etawan te Manama ka eggukum te me etew kayi te ampew te tane keureme? Na, emun ke sikaniyu ma ka eggukum kandan, mania te kene kew egpekewusey te dereisek de ne ehetanan? 3 Ware kew nakataha ne sikanta ka eggukum te me panalihan? Ne iyan naan pa iya ka meyitenged te peg-ugpe te me etew te seini ne kalibutan! 4 Sikan naa, emun ke due ehetanan due te kaniyu, mania te iyan niyu egpewusayen ka etew ne ware tahura te migmalintutuu? 5 Mekeyilew-hilew sika! Ware bes sabeka kaniyu ne matagseb ne iyan eggusey te ehetanan te migmalintutuu? 6 Piru, nasi kew egpasumbungey ka neelin ne migpalintutuu, ne diye niyu pe ma te tangkaan te kene egpalintutuu!

61 If/When there_is one of you(pl) who has a complaint to his/her friend/cousin/brother in believing, why does he/she take it to a judge who doesn't believe? The people of God are (the ones who) should resolve it. 2 Don't you(pl) know that the people of God (will be) the (ones who) will_judge the people on top of the earth in_the_future? Now_then, if you(pl) (are) the (ones who) will_judge them, why can't you(pl) resolve just a small conflict? 3 Don't you(pl) know that we(incl) ((are) the ones who) will_judge the angels? And how much more then about the living of the people of this world! 4 So then, if/when there_is a conflict among you(pl), why do you(pl) get_ a person who doesn't respect believers _to_resolve (it)? 5 That is very_shameful! Is there not one [surprise] of you(pl) who is wise who (could) resolve a conflict of believer(s)? 6 But, instead you(pl) who are all believers report_each_other, and there [emphasis] in front of (one who) doesn't believe!

7 Sika se pegpasumsumbungey niyu, migpakita re iya te pegkatalu niyu. Mania te kene kew egpaleig-leig en iya! Mania te kene kew man-e egpalimbung en iya! 8 Piru, nasi e ne sikaniyu ka migpanleig-leig wey migpanlimbung, wey inggimu niyu sika minsan diye te suled niyu te pegpalintutuu!

7 This your(pl) reporting_each_other, just indeed reveals your(pl) losing. How come you(pl) don't cause_(yourselves)_to_be_taken_advantage_of! How come you(pl) don't also cause_(yourselves)_to_be_cheated! 8 But, instead it's you(pl) (who) take_advantage_of and cheat (others), and you(pl) did this even to your(pl) friends/cousins of faith/believing!

9 Ware kew bes nakataha ne seeye se kene ne matareng, kene egpekeugpe te Migharian te Manama? Kene niyu limbungi ka pegkeetew niyu, su ka egpeyibhilabetey ne kene ne alunggun, ka egsimba te me diyus-diyus, ka egmanlibug, ka me lukes ne eg-ealig te iling dan, 10 ka takawen, ka halamlamen, ka talewubug, ka talabayungen, wey ka tulisan, kene iya egpekeugpe te Migharian te Manama. 11 Ne pila kaniyu dengan ka miggimu te iling due. Piru pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, wey te Panisingan te Manama ta, nalinisan kew e te me sale niyu, namatulus kew e, wey in-isip kew e te Manama ne matareng.

9 Don't you(pl) know that those who are not righteous, can't_live in the Reigning_Place of God? Don't deceive(pl) yourselves, because the (ones who) interfere_with_each_other who (are) not a couple, the (ones who) worship false_gods, the (ones who) cheat, the males who sexually_desire ones_like them, 10 thief(s), lustful (ones), drunkard(s), accuser(s), and robber(s), can't_ indeed _live in the Reigning_Place of God. 11 And some of you(pl) did like that before. But by_means of the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, and of the Spirit of our(incl) God, you(pl) were cleaned from your(pl) sins, you(pl) became_holy, and you(pl) were considered by God to be righteous.

Ugpaan te Magbebaye ka lawa te etew

The body of a person is the living_place of the Lord

12 [xr]Due duma ne egkahi, “Intuhutan a ne eggimu te minsan nekey.” Uya iya, piru kene ne langun ne egpakameupiya kanta. Sikeddi degma, egpakakahi a, “Intuhutan a ne eggimu te minsan nekey,” piru kena a egkeupian ne egpeuripen te minsan nekey. 13 Egkahi ka duma, “Inggimu ka keenen eyew igtahu diye te getek, ne inggimu ka getek eyew egtahuan te keenen.” Uya buwa, piru keureme, ware tapid due ne egdereetan te Manama. Piru ka lawa mule, kene ne para te egpeyibhilabetey ne kene ne alunggun, ke kene, para re te Magbebaye, ne ka Magbebaye para te lawa. 14 Keureme, ka Manama ka eg-uyag kanta pinaahi te geem din, iling te peg-uyag din te Magbebaye.

12 [xr]There are some/others who say, “I am allowed to do anything.” Yes indeed, but not everything will_be_good for us(incl). I also, I can_say, “I am permitted to do anything,” but I don't want to become_a_slave to anything. 13 Others say, “Food was_made in_order to put into the stomach, and the stomach was_made in_order for putting_in food.” Yes maybe, but in_the_future, both of them will_be_destroyed by God. But the body on_the_contrary, is not for (those) not a couple interfering_each_other, but rather, just for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body. 14 In the future, God is the (one who) will_give_life to us(incl) by_means of his power, like his giving_life to the Lord.

15 Ware kew bes nakataha ne ka lawa niyu, baad te lawa ni Kristu? Sikan naa, kene egkaayun ne ka baad te lawa ni Kristu, eggamiten ta te peggilabet te malitan ne egbebelegye te lawa rin! 16 [xr]Ware kew nakanengneng ne ka lukes ne eggilabet te iling due ne malitan, egkeyimu e ne sabeka sikandan ne lawa? Su nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Ne sikandan se daruwa, egkeyimu ne sabeka.” 17 Piru ka etew ne egkasabeka diye te Magbebaye, egkasabeke e ka geyinawa ran te Magbebaye.

15 Don't you(pl) know that your(pl) body, is part of the body of Christ? So then, it's_ not _possible that the part of the body of Christ, is used to interfere with a woman who sells her body! 16 [xr]Don't you(pl) know that the male who interferes with a woman like that, they will_become one body? Because it's written in the Writings that go, “And those two, will_become one.” 17 But the person who is united in the Lord, his/her breath/love will_be_united with the Lord.

18 Purisu, pakaddiyui niyu ka egpeyilabetey ne kene ne alunggun. Ka duma ne sale te etew, kene egpakarereet te lawa, piru ka etew ne eggilabet te kene ne asawa rin, egpakasale te kandin mismu ne lawa. 19 [xr]Ware kew bes nakanengneng ne ka lawa niyu, timplu ne in-ugpaan te Panisingan te Manama ne imbehey rin kaniyu? Kene ne sikaniyu ka kamuney te lawa niyu su ka Manama. 20 Imbayaran kew e nikandin. Sikan naa, gamita niyu ka lawa niyu eyew te pegdayan te Manama.

18 Therefore, distance_yourselves(pl) from interfering_with_each_other who (are) not a couple. The other sins of people, can't destroy the body, but the person who meddles with (someone who is) not his/her spouse, can_sin against his/her own body. 19 [xr]Don't you(pl) know that your(pl) body(s), are a/the temple lived_in by the Spirit of God that he gave you(pl)? It's not you(pl) who (are) the owner of your(pl) body(s) because it's God. 20 You(pl) were paid already by him. So then, use(pl) your(pl) body(s) for praising God.

Ka pegtambag meyitenged te asaweey

Advice about marrying

71 Na, seini ka tambag ku meyitenged te inse niyu diye te sulat: meupiya iya perem ne kene eg-asawa[fn] ka lukes. 2 Piru puun su masalig ka egpeyibhilabetey ne kene ne alunggun, keilangan ne eg-asawa iya ka lukes, ne iling ded degma ka malitan. 3 Ka alunggun, keilangan ne egpewulirey. Ka lukes, keilangan ne eggulid te asawa rin, ne iling ded degma ka malitan. 4 Ka malitan, kenad ne iyan egkamkamuney te lawa rin, ke kene, ka asawa rin e. Ne iling ded degma ka lukes, kenad e ne sikandin ka egkamkamuney te lawa rin su ka asawa rin e degma. 5 Kene kew kene-kene ke eggulid ka asawa niyu kaniyu, angin e ke nekegsabut kew ne kene kew pad egpewulirey su eyew eggamiten niyu ka timpu niyu te peg-ampu. Pegkapenga te nasabutan niyu, keilangan ne egpewulirey kew e man-e, su kema ke egkatintal kew ni Meibulan tenged su kene niyud e egkatigkel ka alig niyu.

71 Now_then, this is my advice about your(pl) question in the letter: it's indeed good for a male not to marry.[fn] 2 But because many interfere_with_each_other who (are) not a couple, a man indeed needs to marry, and a woman likewise. 3 A couple, need to sleep_together. The male, needs to sleep_with his spouse, and the woman likewise. 4 A woman, does not own her body, but rather, her spouse (does). And the man likewise, he doesn't own his body because his spouse (does) also. 5 Don't(pl) prohibit your(pl) spouse(s) from sleeping_with you(pl), unless you(pl) have agreed that you(pl) won't get sleep_together so_that you(pl) can use the time for praying. When_ your(pl) agreement has _finished, you(pl) need to sleep_together again, because what if you(pl) are tempted by Satan because you(pl) can't control your(pl) desire_for_the_opposite_sex.

6 Kene ne inlalag ku seini ne menu insuhu ku sikaniyu, ke kene, intuhutan ku re sikaniyu ne eg-asawa. 7 Meupiya perem ke langun niyu ne iling pad keddiey, piru imbehayan te Manama ka tagse sabeka te katuenan ne ware peg-ilinga.

6 I didn't say this to command you(pl), but rather, I am just permitting you(pl) to marry. 7 It would_be better if all of you(pl) were just like me, but each one is given skills/knowledge by God that's not the same.

8 Egnangenan ku sikaniyu se ware pad nenakaasawa, wey sikaniyu se me balu, te meupiya pad perem ke egpekeiling kew keddiey te ware mig-asawa. 9 Piru ke kene kew egpakatigkel te eggeramen niyu, egkaayun ne eg-asawa kew. Su meupiya pad ka eg-asawa du te egkeyirapan tenged te igkeupii te lawa niyu.

8 I tell you(pl) who haven't yet married(pl), and you(pl) widows, that it's better if you(pl) can_imitate me in not marrying. 9 But if you(pl) can't control what_ you(pl) _are_feeling, it's_possible for you(pl) to marry. Because it's better to marry than to suffer_difficulty due to the desire(s) of your(pl) body(s).

10 [xr]Ne sikaniyu se manggiasawe e, due iglalag ku kaniyu, ne kene ne suhu ku seini, su suhu te Magbebaye. Ka asawa ne malitan, keilangan ne kene egpakigsuwey te asawa rin. 11 Piru ke egpakigsuwey sikandin, keilangan ne kene sikandin eg-abey eg-asawa wey ke meupiya pad ke egpekeg-uli ka meupiya ne geyinawa ran. Ne ka lukes degma, keilangan ne kene egpakigsuwey te asawa rin.

10 [xr]And you(pl) who are already married, I have something_to_say to you(pl), and this is not my command, because it's the command of the Lord. The female spouse, needs to not separate from her spouse. 11 But if she separates, it's_necessary that she doesn't marry again or it's better if their good relationship (LT breath) is restored_to_each_other. And also the man, it's_necessary that he doesn't separate from his spouse.

12 Seini ka iglalag ku te duma, keddi de seini, kene egpuun te Magbebaye: ke due suled ta ne kene egpalintutuu ka asawa rin, piru eg-uyun ka malitan ne eg-ugpe pad duma kandin, keilangan ne kene sikandin egpakigsuwey te asawa rin. 13 Ne ke due degma malitan ne kene egpalintutuu ka asawa rin, piru eg-uyun ka lukes ne eg-ugpe pad duma kandin, keilangan ne kene sikandin egpakigsuwey te lukes. 14 Su ka lukes ne ware migpalintutuu, in-isip te Manama ne sakup din pinaahi te asawa rin ne migpalintutuu. Ne ka malitan ne ware migpalintutuu, in-isip degma te Manama ne sakup din pinaahi te asawa rin ne migpalintutuu. Su emun ke kene pa ne iling due, egpekeiling e perem ka me anak dan te me anak te seeye se ware migpalintutuu. Piru ka malehet, in-isip e degma sikandan te Manama ne sakup din tenged kandan te alunggun. 15 Piru ke egkeupian ne egpakigsuwey te asawa rin seeye se ware migpalintutuu, tuhuti niyu sikandin. Te iling due ne paahi, kenad e egkabakus ka asawa ne migpalintutuu, su in-alam ki te Manama ne eg-ugpe ne malinawen. 16 Su sikeykew se malitan ne migpalintutuu, ware ka nakataha ke egkeuyan nu naan ded ka asawa nu wey se kene. Ne sikeykew degma se lukes, ware ka degma nakataha ke egkeuyan nu naan ded ka asawa nu wey se kene.

12 This is what_ I _have_to_say to others, this is just me, not from the Lord: If we(incl) have a friend/cousin whose spouse doesn't believe, but the woman agrees to still live with him, it's_necessary that he doesn't separate from his spouse. 13 And if there_is also a woman whose spouse doesn't believe, but the male agrees to live with her, it's_necessary that she doesn't separate from the man. 14 Because the man who doesn't believe, is considered by God as his follower due to his spouse who believes. And the woman who doesn't believe, is also considered by God as his follower due to her spouse who believes. Because if it wasn't like that, their children would_be like children of those who don't believe. But the truth is, they are also considered by God as his follower(s) due to them the couple. 15 But if that (one) who doesn't believe wants to leave his/her spouse, let(pl) him/her. By means like that, the spouse who believes is not hindered, because we(incl) are chosen by God to live peacefully. 16 Because you(sg) the woman (who) believes, you(sg) don't know if you(sg) can_bring_along your(sg) spouse or not. And you(sg) also the man, you(sg) don't know if you(sg) can_bring_along your(sg) spouse or not.

Pabulus kew ugpe ke nekey kew te peg-umew te Manama kaniyu

Continue(pl) living in what you(pl) were at God's calling of you(pl)

17 Keilangan ne ka tagse sabeka, egpabulus eg-ugpe sumale te peg-ugpe ne igbehey te Magbebaye kandin, ne iyan sika se peg-ugpe din te timpu te peg-alam te Manama kandin. Iling kayi ka impanulu ku diye te langun ne punduk te migmalintutuu ne egkeendiyaan ku. 18 Ke natuli e ka etew te peg-alam te Manama kandin, kene perem ne keilangan ne eg-aween din ka tulak te pegtuli kandin. Ne emun ke ware pad sikandin natuli te peg-alam kandin te Manama, kene ne keilangan ne egpatuli pad sikandin. 19 Su kene ne impurtanti ke natuli ka etew wey se ware. Iyan de impurtanti ka pegtuman te me suhu te Manama. 20 Ka tagse sabeka, keilangan ne egpabulus te keugpe din ke nekey sikandin te peg-alam te Manama kandin. 21 Emun ke uripen ka te peg-alam te Manama keykew, balahara nu sika. Piru ke due kaayunan ne egpakalihawang ka, palimmakuti nu sika. 22 Su emun ke uripen ka te timpu ne in-alam ka te Magbebaye, in-isip kad e kuntee te Magbebaye ne kene ne uripen. Ne iling ded degma, emun ke kene ka ne uripen te peg-alam te Magbebaye keykew, neyimu kad e kuntee ne uripen ni Kristu. 23 Imbayaran kew e te Manama, purisu kene kew e peuripen te me etew. 24 Purisu me suled, ka tagse sabeka kaniyu, keilangan ne egpabulus ne eg-ugpe ke nekey ka peg-ugpe din te peg-alam te Manama kandin.

17 It's_necessary that each one, continues to live according to the living that was_given to him/her by the Lord, which is that living of his/her at the time of God's choosing him/her. What_ I _taught to all the groups of believers that I go to is like this. 18 If a person was circumcised at God's choosing of him, it shouldn't be necessary that he removes the scar of his circumcision. And if he is not yet circumcised at his choosing by God, it's_ not _necessary that he still be circumcised. 19 Because it's not important if a person is circumcised or not. What's important is the obeying of the commands of God. 20 Each one, needs to continue in his/her living whatever he was at God's choosing of him/her. 21 If you(sg) were a slave at the God's choosing of you(sg), ignore(sg) that. But if there's a possibility that you(sg) can become_free, take_ that _opportunity. 22 Because if you(sg) were a slave at the time that you(sg) were_chosen by the Lord, the Lord considers you(sg) now to be not a slave. And also like that, if you(sg) were not a slave at Lord's choosing of you(sg), you(sg) have now become a slave of Christ. 23 You(pl) were paid already by God, therefore don't become_enslaved to people. 24 Therefore friends/cousins, each one of you(pl), it's_necessary that (he/she) continue to live like his/her living at God's choosing of him/her.

Ka inse meyitenged te ware pad asawa wey te me balu

The question about (those) not yet married and about widows

25 Na, meyitenged te seeye se ware pad nakaasawa: ware suhu keddiey ne egpuun te Magbebaye, piru seini ka tambag ku isip etew ne egkasalihan tenged te hid-u te Manama.

25 Now_then, concerning those not yet married: I don't have a command from the Lord, but this is my advice as a person who is trustworthy due to the mercy of God.

26 Tenged te keyirapan te seini kuntee ne timpu, insuman-suman ku ne meupiya pad perem ke egpabulus kew pad te peg-ugpe niyu kuntee. 27 Emun ke nakaasawa kad, kene ka pakigsuwey te asawa nu. Ne emun ke ware asawa nu, kene kad e mule pamitew te eg-asaween nu. 28 Piru emun ke eg-asawa ke ma iya, kene ke red egpakasale; ne emun ke eg-asawa ka mengebay, kene ded sikandin egpakasale. Piru seeye se egmangasawa te seini ne timpu, egpakabaye te me keyirapan te peg-ugpe dan, ne iyan ku perem igkeupii ne kene kew egpakabaye due.

26 Due to the difficulties of this_ time _now, I thought that it would_be better if you(pl) still continue in your(pl) living now. 27 If you(sg) are married, don't separate from your(sg) spouse. And if you(sg) don't have a spouse, don't on_the_contrary search for who_ you(sg) _will_marry. 28 But if you(sg) indeed marry, you(sg) won't sin; and if the single_woman marries, she also won't be sinning. But those who marry in this time, will_go_through difficulties in their living, and I would like that you(pl) don't go_through that.

29 Seini ka igpasabut ku me suled: malepet naan de ka nasame ne timpu. Ne puun kuntee seeye se manggiasawe e ne me lukes, keilangan ne egpamakey sikandan ne hendue te ware asawa ran. 30 Ne seeye se eglungku, keilangan ne eg-ugpe sikandan ne hendue te ware miglungku; ne seeye se egkahale, keilangan ne eg-ugpe ne hendue te ware nahale; seeye se migpameli, keilangan ne henduen de te kene ne kandan ka egpameliyen dan. 31 Emun ke eggamit ki te minsan nekey kayi te ampew te tane, keilangan ne kene ki perem egkatiglingey due, su ka peg-ugpe ta te seini ne kalibutan, mahaan de egkataman.

29 This is what_ I _mean friends/cousins: the remaining time is short. And from now those married men, need to serve as_if they have_no spouses. 30 And those who grieve, it's_necessary that they live as_if not grieving; and those who are happy, it's_necessary that they live as_if not happy; those who have bought, it's_necessary to live just as_if what_ they _bought is not theirs. 31 If we(incl) use anything here on top of the earth, we(incl) shouldn't be preoccupied with that, because our(incl) living in this world, will_ soon _be_finished.

32 Iyan ku igkeupii ne kene kew egkasasew te peg-ugpe niyu. Ka lukes ne ware asawa, iyan din de igkasasew ka himu te Magbebaye, ke egmenuwen din sikandin te pegpahale. 33 Piru ka lukes ne nakaasawe e, egkasasew te langun-langun de kayi te ampew te tane, wey ke egmenuwen din te pegpahale te asawa rin, 34 ne sika ka egpuunan ne egkabaad ka suman-suman din. Ne iling ded degma ka malitan ne ware asawa, wey ke mengebay pad iya, iyan din de igkasasew ka meyitenged te himu te Magbebaye, su egkeupian sikandin ne igbehey rin te Manama ka umul rin, ware tapid te lawa rin wey te gimukud din. Piru ka malitan ne nakaasawe e, egkasasew sikandin meyitenged te langun-langun de kayi te ampew te tane, ke egmenuwen din te pegpahale te asawa rin.

32 What I want is that you(pl) are not concerned/worried about your(pl) living. The man without a spouse, what he can be concerned_about is the work of the Lord, how to please him. 33 But the man who is married, is concerned about everything here on (LIT above) the earth, and how he will_be_pleasing his spouse, 34 and that's the reason that his thinking is divided. And also likewise the woman without a spouse, or if she's still single, what_ she's _concerned about is the work of the Lord, because she wants to give God her life, both her body and her soul. But the woman who is already married, she is concerned concerning just everything here on top of the earth, how she will_be_pleasing her spouse.

35 Inlalag ku seini eyew te pegbulig kaniyu, ne kene ne pegbalabag kaniyu, ke kene, eyew egmeupiya ka peg-ugpe niyu wey ware egpakabalabag te pegpamakey niyu te Magbebaye.

35 I said this in_order for helping you(pl), and not for blocking you(pl), but rather, so_that your(pl) living will_become_good and there_will_be_nothing able_to_block you(pl) serving the Lord.

36 Na, ke due lukes ne egpangasawa ne nakasuman-suman ne nekeyimu sikandin te kene ne eleg diye te egpangasaween din, wey eglised e sikandin ka egtigkel te eggeramen din, wey pegsuman-suman din ne eleg en iya ne egpeg-asaweey e sikandan, meupiya pad ke egpakasal e sikandan. Kene ne sale sika. 37 Piru ke nakapalene-lene e ka geyinawa rin ne kene eg-asawa, wey te suman-suman din ne kene ne keilangan su egpakatigkel sikandin, meupiya ka eggimuwen din. 38 Purisu, seeye se eg-asawa te tratu rin, meupiya ka eggimuwen din, piru meupiya pad seeye se kene eg-asawa.

36 Now then, if there's a man getting married who thinks that he did (something) not right to his fiance, and if he struggles to control what_ he's _feeling, and his thinking is that it's correct that they get_married, it would_be better that they have_a_wedding. That's not a sin. 37 But if his breath/love is relaxed in not marrying, and in his thinking it's_ not _necessary because he can_get_under_control, his doing is good. 38 Therefore, the (one who) marries his girlfriend, his doing is good, but not marrying is better.

39 Ka manggiasawa ne malitan, kene egkaayun ne eg-abey pad sikandin eg-asawa ke neuyag pad ka asawa rin. Piru ke egpatey e ka iglukes din, egkaayun e man-e sikandin ne eg-asawa ke hentew ka igkeupii rin, piru keilangan ne ka lukes, due pegpalintutuu te Magbebaye. 40 Piru ke sikeddi ka egpalalahen, subla pad ne meupiya ke kenad e eg-asawa sikandin. Sika ka isip ku wey te keddi ne suman-suman, ka Panisingan te Manama ka migpanulu keddi due.

39 The married woman, it's_ not _possible for her to marry again if her spouse is still alive. But if her husband dies, it's_possible that she marries again however she wants, but it's_necessary that the man, has faith/believing in the Lord. 40 But if it's me that's being_asked_to_say, it's much better if she doesn't marry (again). That's my thought and in my thinking, the Spirit of God taught me that.

Ka keenen ne inhalad e diye te diyus-diyus

Food that has been_offered to false_god(s)

81 Na, meyitenged te keenen ne inhalad e diye te diyus-diyus: malehet iya ka ingkahi niyu ne sikanta langun, nakataha kid e meyitenged due. Ne minsan ke nakataha kid te ware karuan te peghalad diye te diyus-diyus, hendue te malemu re ka pegpeggasal ta, piru ke due geyinawa ta, egpakalig-en ki te duma ta te pegpalintutuu. 2 Ke due etew ne egsuman-suman ne due katuenan din, ware din naan pad nanengnengi ke nekey ka kulang te natuenan din. 3 Piru ka minsan hentew ne eggeyinawa te Manama, neila sikandin te Manama.

81 Now_then, concerning food that has been_offered to false_god(s): it's indeed correct what_ you(pl) _said that we(incl) all, we(incl) already know about that. And even though we(incl) know that there_is_no point in offering to false_gods, it's like it's just easy for us(incl) to boast, but if we(incl) have love/breath, we(incl) can strengthen our(incl) companion(s) in believing/faith. 2 If there_is a person that thinks that he/she has some knowledge/skill, he/she doesn't yet know what he/she is lacking in his knowledge/skill. 3 But whoever loves God, he is known by God.

4 Sikan naa, meyitenged man-e te pegkeen te keenen ne inhalad e diye te me diyus-diyus: nakataha kid e ne ka diyus-diyus, kene iya ne malehet ne manama, wey warad e lein ne Manama su sabeka re iya. 5 Su minsan ke due egkahiyen te me etew ne me manama diye te langit wey kayi te tane, wey minsan masalig ka manama wey ahalen, 6 piru sikanta mule, sabeka re ka Manama. Sikandin ka Amey ne iyan miggimu te langun wey ka migpuunan ne neuyag ki. Ne sabeka re ka Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, ne pinaahi kandin, inggimu ka langun-langun de iya, wey pinaahi man-e kandin, due umul ta ne ware egtamanan.

4 So then, again about eating food that has been_offered to false_gods: we(incl) know that the false_god(s), are not indeed correct god(s), and there's_no other God because he is just one. 5 Because even if there are what people think/regard as gods in heaven/sky and here on earth, and even if there are many god(s) and master(s), 6 but (for) us(incl) on_the_contrary, God is just one. He (is) the Father who made everything and the reason that we(incl) are alive. And the Lord Jesus Christ is just one, and by_means_of him, everything was just made, and also by_means_of him, we(incl) have life without ending.

7 Piru kene ne langun ne migmalintutuu ne nakataha meyitenged due. Ka duma, nalayam te diyus-diyus dengan, ne taman kuntee, egsumsumanen dan ded ne ka sika ne pegkeen ne nahalad e, kandin iya te diyus-diyus. Ne puun su mahuye ka kunsinsya ran, egkaheram dan ne egmalindit sikandan ke egkeen due. 8 Piru ka keenen, kene ne iyan egpuunan ne egkahale ka Manama kanta. Ware egkaangey ta wey ware egkalaag kanta ke egkeen ki due wey se kene.

7 But it's not all believers that know about that. The others, were accustomed to false_god(s) before, and until now, they think that that food that has been_offered, indeed belongs to the false_god. And since their conscience is weak, they feel dirtied if they eat that. 8 But the food, is not the reason that God is pleased with us(incl). We(incl) can't get anything and we(incl) don't lose anything whether we(incl) eat that or not.

9 Piru minsan ke due kaligwangan niyu te pegkeen te minsan nekey, keilangan ne egbantey kew, su kema ke sika ka egpakabalabag te seeye se mahuye pad se pegpalintutuu. 10 Panunggiling ke egkeen ka diye te timplu te diyus-diyus, sikeykew se duen e katuenan meyitenged due, ne egkiteen ka mule te seeye se etew ne eg-isip te sale ka egkeen te inhalad e, kema ke egkabagget e sikandin ne egkeen degma. 11 Purisu, egkareetan sika se suled nu ne mahuye se pegpalintutuu, tenged te sika se “katuenan” nu, ne si Kristu, migpeyimatey red degma para kandin. 12 Te iling due ne paahi, nakasale ka ki Kristu tenged su nakasale ka te me suled nu ne mahuye se pegpalintutuu, pinaahi te inggimu nu ne nakabagget kandan te peggimu te iling dutu ne supak te kunsinsya ran. 13 Sikan naa, emun ke iyan egpuunan ka egkeenen ku ne egpakasale ka suled ku, kena ad e egkeen te ngalap eyew kena a egkeyimu ne egpuunan ne egpakasale sikandin.

9 But even if you(pl) have freedom to eat anything, you(pl) need to guard, because what if that's the thing_that_will_obstruct those whose faith/believing is weak. 10 For_example if you(sg) eat at the temple of the false_god(s), you(sg) who have knowledge/skill about that, and you(sg) are seen by those people who on_the_contrary consider that eating what has been_offered is a sin, what if he/she is encouraged to also eat. 11 Therefore, your(sg) friend/cousin whose faith/believing is weak will_be_destroyed, due to your(sg) “knowledge/skill”, and Christ, died_intentionally also for him/her. 12 By means like that, you(sg) have_sinned against Christ because you(sg) sinned against your(sg) friend/cousin whose faith/believing is weak, by_means of what_ you(sg) _did that encouraged them to do like that which was against their conscience. 13 So then, if what_ I _eat is the reason that my friend/cousin sins, I won't eat meat/fish so_that I won't become the reason that he/she sins.

Ka katenged te apustulis

The authority of an apostle

91 Sikeddi seini, duen e kaligwangan ku, menu ma iya? Ne apustulis e red man-e, tenged su nakakita a iya ki Hisus ne Magbebaye ta, wey sikaniyu mismu ka behas te himu ku ne imbehey te Magbebaye keddiey. 2 Ke kene e ma ne apustulis diye te suman-suman te duma, asal naan ubag due te kaniyu. Su sikaniyu se migpalintutuu ka igkapamalehet ne apustulis a iya te Magbebaye.

91 This is me, I have my freedom, isn't that (right)? And I am also an apostle, because I really saw Jesus our(incl) Lord, and you(pl) (are) the fruit of my work that the Lord gave to me. 2 If I am not an apostle in the thinking of others, at least I am to you(pl) [embarrassedly]. Because you(pl) who believe are what_proves that I am indeed an apostle of the Lord.

3 Seini ka igtabak ku te seeye se eg-ugsi-ugsi keddiey: 4 emun ke malehet ma ne apustulis key, ware naan en iya katenged ney te pegdawat te keenen wey inumen ne igsendad kanami te seeye se napanulu ney? 5 Ware naan e katenged ney ne egduruma te me asawa ne migpalintutuu iling te eggimuwen te me suled te Magbebaye, wey te duma ne me apustulis, wey ni Pidru? 6 Wey ke, sikanami naan de iya ki Birnabi ka keilangan ne egtrabahu eyew egkeuyag key? 7 Duen naa sundalu ne egbayaran din mismu ka pegkasundalu rin? Duen naa migpamula ne kene ne iyan egpakakeen te pinamula rin? Duen naa talagtameng te me karniru ne kene ne iyan eg-inum te gatas te intamengan din?

3 This is my answer to that/those who evaluate me: 4 if it's correct that we(excl) are apostle(s), don't we(excl) have any authority for receiving food and drink that is served to us(excl) to those that we(excl) taught? 5 Don't we(excl) have any authority to take_along believing spouses like the friends/cousins of the Lord did, and the other apostles, and Pidru? 6 Or, is it just Barnabas (MS Bernabi) and I that need to work in_order that we(excl) can_live? 7 Is there a soldier who pays for his/her own soldiering? Is there one_who_plants who can't_eat what_ he/she _planted? Is there one_looking_after sheep who doesn't drink the milk of what_ he/she _is_looking_after?

8 Seini se inlalag ku, kene ne inetew-etew re ne suman-suman, ke kene, seini red degma ka impanulu diye te Balaud ni Muwisis. 9 [xr]Su nasulat sika diye te Balaud ne miggenendue, “Kene nu pungesa ka be-be te baka ke igdiriek sikandin.” Mania, me baka re ka igkasasew te Manama? 10 Klaru ne sikanta ka igpasabut din te inlalag din. Uya iya, insulat seeye para kanami, tenged su seeye se me talagdaru wey talaggaani, egpallateng sikandan ne egpakarawat te baad dan. 11 [xr]Puun su migpamula key due te kaniyu te ispirituwanen ne beni, mabehat naan e kaniyu ke egbuyu key te keuyahan ney? 12 Ke duen ma katenged te duma ne egtetahad te egpuun kaniyu, labew key en iya!

8 This that I said, isn't just human thinking, but rather, this is what_was_taught also by the Law of Moses (MS Muwisis). 9 [xr]Because it's written in the Law that goes, “Don't(sg) tie_up the mouth of the cow when it threshes.” Why, is God only concerned about cows? 10 It's clear that we(incl) are what_ he _meant by what_ he _said. Yes indeed, that was_written for us(incl), because those plowers and harvesters, they hope/expect that they will_be_able_to_receive their portion. 11 [xr]Since we(excl) planted spiritual seed in you(pl), is it heavy on you(pl) if we(excl) request our(excl) living_needs? 12 If other(s) have authority to expect (LIT wait for) (something) from you(pl), we(excl) have greater (authority) (LIT are greater) indeed!

Piru ware ney mule gamita ka sika ne katenged, ke kene, in-antus ney ka langun eyew kene egkabalabahan ka pegpangguhud te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Kristu.13 [xr]Ware kew bes nakataha ne seeye se migpamakey diye te timplu, diye egkuwa te egkeenen dan te timplu? Ne seeye se migpamakey degma diye te altar, egkuwa sikandan te baad dan puun te me halad? 14 [xr]Ne iling naan ded degma, migsuhu ka Magbebaye ne seeye se nakarawat te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, keilangan ne iyan egbehey te keuyahan te seeye se migpangguhud kandan te Meupiya ne Panugtulen.

But we(excl) didn't use that authority, but rather, we(excl) suffered everything so_that the storying of the Good Report about Christ wouldn't be blocked.13 [xr]Don't you(pl) know [surprise] that those who serve in the temple, get their food there at the temple? And also those who serve at the altar, they get their portion from the sacrifice? 14 [xr]And just also like that, the Lord commanded those who receive the Good Report, should give a living to those who story them the Good Report.

15 Piru wara a miggamit te sika ne me katenged iling te pegpabulig kaniyu. Ne kene man-e ne iyan ku insulat kayi ne menu egpallateng a ne egbehayan a nikaniyu. Su egmeupiyeen ku pad ka egpatey te gutas du te egkaawe ka katenged ku te pegpeggasal. 16 Ware katenged ku te pegpeggasal meyitenged te pegwali ku te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, su impehes a iya te Manama te peggimu due. Ne mekeyid-u-hid-u a ke kene ku sika eggimuwen. 17 Su emun perem ke eggimuwen ku sika te keddiey ne pegbuut, eleg perem ne eg-unahan a. Piru kene ne keddi sika ne pegbuut, su insalig de te Manama keddi ka sika ne himu. 18 Nekey naan e ka unag ku? Ware lein gawas te egpakawali a te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne ware migpabayad, minsan duen iya perem katenged ku te pegpabayad.

15 But I didn't use those authorities/rights like getting_ you(pl) _to_help (me). And I don't also write this because I hope that I'll be given_to by you(pl). Because I'd rather die of hunger than that my authority for boasting be removed. 16 I have_no authority for boasting about my preaching of the Good Report, because I was indeed persuaded by God to do that. And I am to_be_pitied if I can't do that. 17 Because if I did that from my own will, it would_be correct if I was_rewarded. But that's not my will, because that work was just entrusted by God. 18 What then is my reward? Nothing else except being_able_to_preach the Good Report without requesting payment, even though I should have authority to request_payment.

19 Su minsan ke due kaligwangan ku, wey wara a neuripen te minsan hentew, piru migpeuripen a iya te langun ne etew su eyew masalig ka me etew ne egkeuyan ku. 20 Su emun ke Hudiyu ka me duma ku, mig-ikulan ku degma ka batasan dan su eyew egkeuyan ku sikandan. Ne minsan ke wara a migpasakup te Balaud ni Muwisis, migtuman e red man-e due eyew egkeuyan ku seeye se migpasakup te Balaud. 21 Ne iling naan ded degma, te timpu ne iyan ku duma seeye se kene ne me Hudiyu ne kene eg-ikul te Balaud ni Muwisis, mig-iling a degma kandan ne kene eg-ikul te Balaud, su eyew egkeuyan ku sikandan te pegpalintutuu. Piru kene sika egpasabut ne kena a egtuman te Balaud te Manama, mig-ikul a iya te balaud ni Kristu. 22 Su emun ke diya a te magguye, egpahuye-guya a degma, eyew egkeuyan ku sikandan. Purisu egpamitew a te paahi ne egpekeiling a kandan eyew egkaluwas ku ka duma kandan.

19 Because even if I have freedom, and I wasn't enslaved by anyone, but I enslaved_(myself) indeed to all people so_that I can bring_along many people. 20 Because if Hudiyu(s) (are) my companions, I also followed/imitated their custom(s) so_that I could_carry_ them _along. And even if I am not under_the_jurisdiction of the Law of Moses, I obeyed it anyway so_that I could_carry_along those under_the_jurisdiction of the Law. 21 And also just like that, at the time that my companion(s) were those not Hudiyus who don't follow/imitate the Law of Moses, I copied them also to not follow/imitate the Law, so_that I can carry_ them _along in believing. But that doesn't mean that I don't obey the Law of God, I indeed follow/imitate the law of Christ. 22 Because if I (am) there with (those who) are weak, I become weak also, so_that I can_bring_ them _along. Therefore I search for a means that I can become like them so_that some of them can be_saved.

23 Inggimu ku sika eyew egpekeempet ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen wey eyew egkatalaran a te panalangin te Manama ne egpuun due. 24 Ware kew bes nakataha ne timpu te peglungkesu, egpallahuy seeye se langun ne eg-apil piru sabeka re ka egpakarawat te unag? Sikan naa, pallahuy kew su eyew egkaangey niyu ka unag ne igbehey te Manama kaniyu. 25 Ka langun ne eg-apil te peglungkesu, egbebasbas ne egtigkel te lawa ran. Eggimuwen dan sika su eyew egkarawat dan ka unag ne eglihad de. Piru sikanta mule, eggimuwen ta sika eyew egkarawat ta ka unag ne ware egtamanan. 26 Sikan naa, iyan ku eg-ilingan seeye se migpallahuy ne migpalaheteng diye te katammanan te lumba. Ne eg-ilingan ku man-e seeye se migpasumbahey ne ware migpangawang migpanumbag. 27 Imbasbas ku ka lawa ku wey impegnel ku ka mareet ne igkeupii ku su eyew kena a igsawile pegkapenga ku te pegwali diye te duma.

23 I did that so_that the Good Report will_spread_everywhere and so_that I can be given_a_portion of the blessing of God as_a_result of that. 24 Don't you(pl) know [surprise] that at the time of a race, all those who are included run but only one can_receive a reward? So then, run(pl) so_that you(pl) can_get the reward that God will_give you(pl). 25 All (those) that enter in the race, they practice intensely and control themselves in everything indeed. They do that so_that they can_get the reward that has an ending. But we(incl) on_the_contrary, we(incl) do that so_that we(incl) can get the reward that is without ending. 26 So then, what_ I _copy are those who run and go_straight to the end of the race. And I also copy those who punch_each_other and don't punch without_aiming. 27 I train my body and I stop my bad desire(s) so_that I won't be rejected (LIT thrown_out) when I have finished preaching to other(s).

Ka pegpaney-paney meyitenged te diyus-diyus

The warning about false_god(s)

101 [xra][xrb]Me suled, egkeupian a ne egpakasuman-suman kew te neyitabu dengan te kaap-apuan ta. Imbantayan sikandan langun te Manama pinaahi te gapun, wey nakalapas sikandan diye te Malalab ne Dahat ne ware namenu. 2 Ne pinaahi te pegbantey kandan te gapun wey peglapas dan te dahat, nekeiling te imbewutismuwan sikandan langun isip me sakup ni Muwisis. 3 [xr]Nangeen sikandan langun te keenen ne imbehey te Manama, 4 [xr]wey nanginum sikandan langun te weyig ne impalihawang din diye te batu. Mig-inum sikandan puun te ispirituwanen ne batu ne migduma kandan; ne ka sika ne batu, iyan si Kristu. 5 [xr]Piru minsan pad due, ware ikahale te Manama ka kasuluhan kandan, purisu nammatey sikandan ne napayatpat ka me lawa ran diye te disirtu.

101 [xra][xrb]Friends/cousins, I want you(pl) to think_about/remember what_happened long_ago to our(incl) ancestors. They were watched_over by God by_means of cloud, and they were_able_to_cross the Red Sea without event. 2 And by means of guarding them with cloud and their crossing the sea, it's like they were_ all _baptized as followers of Moses. 3 [xr]They all ate(pl) of food given by God, 4 [xr]and they all drank(pl) water that he caused_to_come_out of a rock. They drank from a spiritual rock that accompanied them; and that rock, was Christ. 5 [xr]But despite that, most of them weren't pleasing to God, therefore they died(pl) and their bodies were_scattered in the desert.

6 [xr]Na, seeye se neyitabu kandan, pegpaney-paney e kanta su eyew kene ki iya egkeinniyat te mareet ne iling te inggimu ran. 7 [xr]Kene kew simba te me diyus-diyus iling te inggimu te me duma ran dengan, su nasulat e te Kasulatan, “Naminnuu ka me etew ne nangiinum wey nangekeen, ne nataman, nanasindeg e ka nanesayew te kahale.” 8 [xr]Keilangan ne kene ki egpeyilabetey ka kene ne alunggun iling te inggimu te duma ran dengan, purisu migpamatey ka 23,000 ne me duma ran te sabeka re ne aldew. 9 [xr]Kene ta eg-el-elehan si Kristu[fn] iling te inggimu te duma ran dengan, purisu nammatey sikandan ka impangahat te me uled. 10 [xr]Keilangan ne kene ki egsalew-salew iling te inggimu te duma ran dengan, purisu indereetan e sikandan te panalihan ne talagdereet.
