6 [xr]Now_then, that that happened to them, warns us(incl) so_that we(incl) greatly won't covet evil like (what) they did. 7 [xr]Don't(pl) worship false_gods like some of them did long_ago, because it's_written in the Writings, “The people sat(pl) and drunk(pl) and ate(pl), and then, (they) stood(pl) to dance(pl) with joy.” 8 [xr]It's_necessary that we(incl) who (are) not a couple don't (sexually)_meddle_together like they did long_ago, therefore 23,000 of them died(pl) in just one day. 9 [xr]We(incl) shouldn't test Christ[fn] like some of them did long_ago, therefore they the (ones) bitten(pl) by snakes died(pl). 10 [xr]It's_necessary that we(incl) don't complain like some of them did long_ago, therefore they were_destroyed by the destroying angel.

11 Neyitabu seeye diye te kandan isip panunggilingan te duma ne etew, wey insulat sika eyew te pegpaney-paney kanta te mig-ugpe te timpu ne mahaan e egkataman ka inged.

11 Those (things) happened to them as an example for other people, and that's written for warning us(incl) who live at the time that the end of the place/world is near.

12 Su emun ke due egsuman-suman ne malig-en e ka pegpalintutuu rin, keilangan ne egbantey sikandin su kema ke egpakasale degma sikandin. 13 Ka peg-eleg-eleg ne nabayaan niyu, iling ded te nabayaan te duma ne me etew. Piru matinumanen ka Manama te saad din wey kene din igtuhut ne kene niyu egkeelehan ka peg-eleg-eleg ne egginguma kaniyu. Emun ke egginguma ka peg-eleg-eleg, egbehayan kew te Manama te paahi eyew egkaantus niyu sika.

12 Because if (some) think his/her faith/believing is strong, he/she needs to guard because what if he/she also sins. 13 The testing that you(pl) are_going_through, is_ just _like what other people have gone_through. But God is faithful to his promise and he doesn't permit that you(pl) couldn't handle the testing that arrives at you(pl). If/when the testing arrives, you(pl) will_be_given by God a means so_that you(pl) can endure that.

14 Sikan naa me pinalangge ku, pakaddiyu kew te pegsimba te me diyus-diyus. 15 Sikaniyu, maheteng ka suman-suman niyu, sikan naa, sumsumana niyu ke eleg ka eglalahen ku wey se kene. 16 [xr]Sikanta se migmalintutuu, emun ke eglibulung ki eyew te pegsuman-suman te kamatayen ni Kristu, due eg-inumen ta ne egpasalamatan ta te Manama, wey due degma egtepik-tepiken ta ne egkeenen ta. Ne pinaahi rue, egpakasawit ki te langesa wey lawa ni Kristu, menu ma iya? 17 Ne minsan masalig ki, henduen de te sabeka ki re ne lawa tenged su sabeka re ne paan ka ingkeen ta.

14 So then my beloved, distance_yourselves from worshiping false_gods. 15 You(pl), your(pl) thinking is sensible, so then, think_about(pl) whether what_ I _say is correct or not. 16 [xr]We(incl) who believe(pl), if/when we(incl) gather for thinking about the death of Christ, we(incl) have something_to_drink that we(incl) thank God, and there_is also bread that we(incl) break that we(incl) eat. And by_means of that, we(incl) participate in the blood and body of Christ, isn't that right? 17 And even_though we(incl) are many, it's as if we(incl) are just one body because the bread that we(incl) ate is just one.

18 [xr]Sumsumana niyu ka keet-etawan te Israil: ka langun ne migkeen te impanubad e, migpakita re iya sikandan ne migsawit e te pegsimba te Manama, menu ma iya? 19 Iyan ku naa igpasabut due ne seeye se diyus-diyus wey ka inhalad e diye te diyus-diyus due karuan? 20 [xr]Kene ne sika! Iyan ku mule igpasabut, ne ka sika ne me halad te kene egpalintutuu, diye dan ihalad te me busew, kene ne diye te Manama. Ne kena a egkeupian ne egpakasabeka kew te me busew. 21 Kene egkaayun ne eg-inum kew puun te ubab te Magbebaye wey te ubab degma te me busew. Kene egkaayun ne egkeen kew diye te keenanan te Magbebaye wey keenanan degma te me busew. 22 [xr]Mania te egpepangalikuren te red iya ka Magbebaye? Manekal ki bes pad kuntere kandin?

18 [xr]Consider(pl) the people of Israil: all that ate of what_had_been_sacrificed, just showed that they participated in the worshiping of God, isn't that right? 19 Is what_ I _mean that those false_god(s) and what is offered to the false_god(s) has purpose? 20 [xr]Not that! What I mean on_the_contrary, is that that offering of (one who) doesn't believe, they offer it to evil_spirits, not to God. And I don't want you(pl) to unite with evil_spirits. 21 It's_ not _possible for you(pl) to drink from the cup of the Lord and also from the cup of evil_spirits. It's_ not _possible for you(pl) to eat at the dining_place of the Lord and to eat also at the dining_place of evil_spirits. 22 [xr]Why do we(incl) cause_the_jealousy of the Lord? Are we(incl) stronger than him?

23 [xr]Due duma ne egkahi ne intuhutan ki kun ne eggimu te minsan nekey, piru, kene ne langun ne egpakabulig wey egpakalig-en kanta. 24 Keilangan ne ware sabeka ne iyan de egsumsumanen ka kandin mismu ne keupianan, ke kene, sika se keupianan te duma.

23 [xr]There are other(s) who say that we(incl) permit anything [hearsay], but, it's not everything that can_help and can_strengthen us(incl). 24 It's_necessary that there_is_no one who just thinks about his/her own desire(s), but rather, those desire(s) of other(s).

25 Keena niyu ka minsan nekey ne ngalap ne igbelegye diye te palingki, piru kene kew e inse ke impakapanubad naan e seeye diye te diyus-diyus wey se ware eyew kene kew e egkunsinsya. 26 [xr]Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan, “Kandin te Magbebaye ka kalibutan wey ka langun ne tahu kayi.”

25 Eat(pl) whatever meat/fish that is sold at the market, but don't(pl) ask if it's been_sacrificed to false_god(s) or not so_that you(pl) won't have_a_bad_conscience. 26 [xr]Because according to what_is_written in the Writings, “The world and everything in it (are) the Lord's.”

27 Emun ke due kene egpalintutuu ne egginggat kaniyu ne diye egkeen te kandan, ne egkeupian kew ne eggendiye, keena niyu ka langun ne igsendad kaniyu. Kene kew e inse-inse ke impakapanubad naa seeye diye te diyus-diyus wey se ware eyew kene kew e egkunsinsya. 28 Piru ke due egnangen kaniyu ne egkahi, “Impanubad man e diye te diyus-diyus ka sika ne sere,” kene kew e keen due. Kene kew e keen due tenged te seeye se etew ne mignangen kaniyu wey tenged te kunsinsya. 29 Kene ne iyan ku igpasabut ka kaniyu ne kunsinsya, ke kene, ka kunsinsya te etew ne mignangen kaniyu. Ke due eg-inse, “Mania te egtigkelen ku ka igkeupii ku tenged te kunsinsya te duma? 30 Ke egpasalamatan ku ma te Manama ka egkeenen ku, mania te egsagsahukul ka me etew keddiey meyitenged te keenen ne egpasalamatan ku?”

27 If there are (those who) don't believe who invite you(pl) to eat there with them, and you(pl) want to go_there, eat(pl) everything that is served_up to you(pl). Don't(pl) ask if it's been_sacrificed to false_god(s) or not so_that you(pl) won't have_a_bad_conscience. 28 But if someone informs you(pl) saying, “That viand has been_sacrificed to false_god(s),” don't(pl) eat it. Don't(pl) eat it due to that person who informed you(pl) and due to conscience. 29 I don't mean your(pl)(emph) conscience, but rather, the conscience of the person who informed you(pl). If someone asks, “Why should I control my desire due to the conscience of other(s)? 30 If I thank God for what_ I _am eating, why do the people complain to me about food that I give_thanks for?”

31 Purisu, emun ke egkeen kew, ke eg-inum kew, wey ke eggimu te minsan nekey, himuwa niyu sika te pegdayan te Manama. 32 Kene kew himu te egpakatameneng te me Hudiyu, Grigu, wey te migmalintutuu te Manama. 33 Ilingi niyu ka inggimu ku ne pegpamitew te paahi ne egkabulihan ka langun. Su wara a migpamitew te keddi ne keupianan, ke kene, sika se keupianan te duma, eyew egkaluwas sikandan.

31 Therefore, if/when you(pl) eat, or you(pl) drink, or you(pl) do anything, do(pl) that to praise God. 32 Don't(pl) do (anything) that irritates Hudiyus, Greeks, or believers in God. 33 Copy(pl) what_ I _did in seeking a way that everyone can be_helped. Because I didn't seek my desire(s), but rather, the desire(s) of other(s), so_that they can_be_saved.

111 [xr]Ilingi a nikaniyu, iling te peg-iling ku degma ki Kristu.

111 [xr]Copy/Imitate(pl) me, like my copying/imitating also of Christ.

Ka pegbubunbun te ulu te pegsimba

The covering of the head when worshiping

2 Egdeyrayen ku sikaniyu tenged su layun a nikaniyu sumsumana, wey in-ikul niyu ka impanulu ku kaniyu. 3 Piru egkeupian a ne egpakasabut kew ne si Kristu ka labew te lukes, ne ka lukes ka labew te asawa rin, ne ka Manama ka labew ki Kristu. 4 Emun ke eglibulung kew te pegsimba, ne due lukes ne eg-ampu wey ke egpangguhud naa te impanengneng te Manama ne egteterung, egpeyilew sikandin ki Kristu ne iyan labew kandin. 5 Piru ke due malitan ne eg-ampu wey ke egpangguhud naa te impanengneng te Manama ne kene egteterung, egpeyilew sikandin te asawa rin ne iyan labew kandin. Nekeiling de te migpeupew sikandin. 6 Su ka malitan ne kene egteterung, keilangan ne egtempuhen ka bulbul rin. Ne puun su egpekeyilew te malitan ka egtempuhan wey ke eg-abuluhan naa, keilangan ne egteterung iya sikandin. 7 [xr]Ka egpuunan ne kene egteterung ka lukes, tenged su alung sikandin te ulaula wey te katelesan te Manama. Piru ka malitan, sikandin iya ka katelesan te lukes. 8 [xr]Su ware himuwa ka lukes puun te malitan, ke kene, ka malitan mule ka diye migpuun te lukes. 9 Ware degma himuwa te Manama ka lukes para te malitan, ke kene, ka malitan mule ka inggimu para te lukes. 10 Purisu, keilangan iya ne egteterung ka malitan te pegpeila ne sakup sikandin te lukes, su minsan ka me panalihan, egbantey kandin. 11 Piru te pegsabeka ta diye te Magbebaye, egkeilangan ded degma te lukes ka malitan, ne iling ded degma ka lukes, egkeilangan ded te malitan. 12 Su minsan te an-anayan, inggimu ka malitan puun te lukes, ne kuntee, ka lukes diye eglesut te malitan. Piru ka langun-langun, diye de iya egpuun te Manama.

2 I praise you(pl) because you(pl) always think about me, and you(pl) copy/imitate what_ I _taught you(pl). 3 But I want you(pl) to understand that Christ is over (in status) a man, and the man is over his spouse, and God is over Christ. 4 If/when you(pl) meet for worshiping, if there_is a male who prays or stories what God has made known who has_(his)_head_covered, he shames Christ who is over him. 5 But if there_is a woman who prays or stories what God has made known and doesn't cover_(her)_head, she shames her spouse who is over her. It's just as if she balds_(her)_head. 6 Because the woman who doesn't cover_(her)_head, needs to have her hair cut_off. And because cutting_off or shaving (the hair) of a woman causes_shame, she indeed needs to cover_(her)_head. 7 [xr]The reason that the man doesn't cover_(his)_head, is because he is a shadow/reflection of the face and of the splendor of God. But the woman, she is indeed the splendor of the man. 8 [xr]Because the man wasn't made from woman, but rather, the woman on_the_contrary came from man. 9 God also didn't make the man for the woman, but rather, the woman was_made on_the_contrary for man. 10 Therefore, it's indeed necessary for the woman to cover_(her)_head for showing that she is under the man, because even the angels, watch/guard her. 11 But in our(incl) uniting in the Lord, the woman needs a man, and the man also, needs a woman. 12 Because even in the beginning, the woman was_made from man, and now, the man is_born from a woman. But everything, comes indeed from God.

13 Sumsumana niyu seini: eleg naa emun ke eg-ampu ka malitan diye te Manama ne kene egteterung? 14 Tapey kid e nakataha ne mekeyilew-hilew ka lukes ne malayat se bulbul, 15 piru ka malitan mule, amana ne tetelesi sikandin ke malayat ka bulbul rin. Su imbehayan sikandin te malayat ne bulbul eyew te pegbunbun te ulu rin. 16 Ke due egkeupian ne egpakig-apul meyitenged kayi, iyan ku re igkalalag kandin ne iling iya rue ne batasan ka in-ikul ney, ne iling ded degma ka inggimu te duma ne migpalintutuu te Manama.

13 Think_about(pl) this: is that correct if a woman prays to God without covering_(her)_head? 14 We(incl) already know that it's shameful for a man with long hair, 15 but a woman on_the_contrary, is very_attractive if her hair is long. Because she was_given long hair for covering her head. 16 If there_is (anybody) who wants to dispute, I just tell him/her that the custom that we(excl) follow is indeed like that, and like that also is what other churches do that believe (in) God.

Ka pegpanulu meyitenged te Iglabung te Magbebaye

The teaching about the Supper of the Lord

(Mat 26:26‑29; Mar 14:22‑25; Luk 22:14‑20)

(Mat 26:26‑29; Mar 14:22‑25; Luk 22:14‑20)

17 Piru ka seup kuntee ne igpanulu ku kaniyu, kena a egpakareyrey kaniyu, tenged su kene egpakameupiya kaniyu ka peglibulung niyu te pegsimba, su nasi egpakarereet kaniyu. 18 Hun-a te langun, nakarineg a ne emun kun ke eglibulung kew, egkabaad-baad kew kun, ne hendue te egpakapalintutuu a due. 19 Su keilangan pad iya ne egkeyitabu sika due te kaniyu su eyew egkeila ke hentew kaniyu ka malehet ne migmalintutuu. 20 Te timpu ne miglibulung kew ka migkeen te pegsuman-suman te kamatayen te Magbebaye, ne egngaranan te Iglabung te Magbebaye, kene ne sikandin ka insuman-suman niyu. 21 Su emun ke egkekeen e, masi keen kew re due te keenen niyu, ne due duma ne eggutasan pad, ne due duma ne egkewubug e. 22 Mania, ware me baley niyu ne egkakeenan niyu wey egkeinuman niyu? Su sika se inggimu niyu, inlemetan niyu ka langun ne migmalintutuu wey impeyilawan niyu ka egkengaayu-ayu. Na, nekey naa ka iglalag ku kaniyu? Egdeyrayen ku naa sikaniyu te sika ne hinimuwan niyu? Kene iya!

17 But the next thing_that_ I _will_teach you(pl), I won't praise you(pl), because your(pl) gathering to worship doesn't do_good to you(pl), because (it) instead ruins you(pl). 18 First of all, I heard that if/when you(pl) gather, you(pl) are divided [hearsay], and I tend to believe that. 19 Because that indeed needs to happen to you(pl) so_that (you) will_know who of you(pl) is a true believer. 20 At the time that you(pl) gather to eat thinking about the death of the Lord, that is called the Supper of the Lord, it's not him that you(pl) are thinking_about. 21 Because when eating, you(pl) eat your(pl) food independently, and there are some who are still hungry, and there are some who are already getting drunk. 22 Why, don't you(pl) have houses that you(pl) can_eat_in and that you(pl) can_drink_in? Because that that_ you(pl) _do, you(pl) mock all the believers and you(pl) shame the poor(pl). Now_then, what_will_ I _say to you(pl)? Will I praise you(pl) for those actions of yours(pl)? Indeed not!

23 Su seini ka impanulu te Magbebaye keddiey ne impanulu kud degma due te kaniyu: ka Magbebaye ne si Hisus, migkuwa te paan te seeye ne karusileman te eg-akalan e sikandin, 24 wey te nakapasalamat e sikandin te Manama, impanepik-tepik din e seeye te migkahi, “Seini ka lawa ku ne igpanubad para kaniyu. Himuwa niyu seini te pegsuman-suman keddiey.” 25 [xra][xrb]Pegkapenga ran te migkeen, iling ded man-e ka inggimu ni Hisus te pegkuwa rin te ubab, kahi rin, “Seini ne ubab, ka iyam ne kasabutan te Manama ne egpamalehetan pinaahi te langesa ku. Tagse eg-inum kew kayi, himuwa niyu sika te pegsuman-suman keddiey.” 26 Tagse egkeen kew te seini ne paan wey eg-inum puun te seini ne ubab, ipangguhud niyu naa ka kamatayen te Magbebaye taman te peglibed din man-e.

23 Because this is what_ the Lord _taught me that I also taught to you(pl): the Lord Jesus, took bread on that night when he was betrayed, 24 and when he had_given_thanks to God, he broke it and said, “This is my body which will_be_sacrificed for you(pl). Do(pl) this when you(pl) think_about me.” 25 [xra][xrb]When they finished eating, Jesus did the same thing when taking the cup, he said, “This cup, is the new agreement with God that is witnessed to by_means of my blood. Each (time) you(pl) drink this, you(pl) do that while remembering me.” 26 Each (time) you(pl) eat this bread and drink from this cup, you(pl) tell about the death of the Lord until his_coming again.

27 Purisu, ka minsan hentew ne egkeen te paan wey eg-inum puun te ubab te Magbebaye te kene ne eleg ne paahi, nakasale sikandin te lawa wey te langesa te Magbebaye. 28 Keilangan ne ka tagse etew, eg-ugsi-ugsi te pegkeetew rin, ne hendue egkeen te paan wey eg-inum puun te ubab. 29 Su ke kene niyu eg-ileen ka kaluwasan te lawa te Magbebaye te pegkeen niyu te paan wey peg-inum niyu puun te ubab, eggukuman kew te pegkeen wey peg-inum niyu rue. 30 Sikan naa ka masalig kaniyu ka mahuye-guye wey egmanderalu, wey due duma ne nammatey e. 31 Piru ke eg-ug-ugsiyen ta iya ka pegkeetew ta, kene ki perem egkewukuman. 32 Piru emun ke eggukuman ki te Magbebaye, egdisiplineen ki naa nikandin, eyew kene ki egpakalagkes egkaparuseyi te seeye se ware migpalintutuu.

27 Therefore, whoever eats the bread and drinks from the cup of the Lord in a not correct way, he/she sins (against) the body and blood of the Lord. 28 It's_necessary that each person, investigates him/herself, and then eats the bread and drinks from the cup. 29 Because if you(pl) don't recognize the salvation of the body of the Lord in your(pl) eating bread and your(pl) drinking from the cup, you(pl) will_be_judged for your(pl) eating and drinking there. 30 That's why many of you(pl) are weak(pl) and sick(pl), and there are some who have already died(pl). 31 But if we(incl) indeed investigate ourselves, we(incl) wouldn't be judged. 32 But if we(incl) are judged by the Lord, we(incl) are disciplined by him, so_that we(incl) won't be included in the punishment of those who don't believe.

33 Purisu me suled ku, emun ke eglibulung kew ka egpangekeen te Iglabung te Magbebaye, patagtaharey kew ka tagse sabeka. 34 Ke due sabeka ne eggutasan, keilangan ne diyad sikandin egkeen te baley rin, su eyew kene kew egkewukuman te Manama ke eglibulung kew. Na, meyitenged te duma pad ne diye te sulat niyu, duen kud e eglalaha te peggenduen ku.

33 Therefore my friends/cousins, if/when you(pl) meet to eat(pl) the Supper of the Lord, each one should wait_for_each_other. 34 If there_is one who is hungry, he/she needs to eat at his/her house, so_that you(pl) won't be judged by God when you(pl) meet. Now_then, concerning other (things) in your(pl) letter, I will_speak to them on my coming.

Ka katuenan ne imbehey te Panisingan te Manama

The skill(s)/knowledge given by the Spirit of God

121 Na, me suled, egkeupian a ne egpakasabut kew meyitenged te katuenan ne imbehey te Manama. 2 Nakataha kew e, ne timpu te ware kew pad migpalintutuu te Manama, neuyan kew te nalein-lein ne paahi eyew te pegsimba te me diyus-diyus ne kene egpakalalag. 3 Sikan naa, egkeupian a ne egpakataha kew ne ware etew ne in-umaan te Panisingan te Manama ne egpakarilus ki Hisus. Ne ware degma etew ne egpakakahi ne Magbebaye si Hisus ke ware sikandin umeyi te Panisingan te Manama.

121 Now_then, friends/cousins, I want for you(pl) to be_able_to_understand about skill(s)/knowledge given by God. 2 You(pl) already know, that at the time that you(pl) didn't yet believe (in) God, you(pl) were_taken on various ways for worshiping false_gods that can't speak. 3 That's why, I want you(pl) to know that no person with the Spirit of God in_him/her can_curse Jesus. And also no person can_say that Jesus is Lord if he/she doesn't have the Spirit of God (in him/her).

4 [xr]Due nalein-lein ne klasi te me katuenan ne igbehey te Manama te migmalintutuu, piru sikan ded ne Panisingan ka egpuunan due. 5 Due degma nalein-lein ne paahi te pegpamakey ta, piru sikan ded ne Magbebaye ka egpamakayen ta. 6 Ne due man-e nalein-lein ne igpeyimu te Manama kanta, piru sikan ded ne Manama ka egbulig kanta langun te eggimu rue. 7 Egbehayan te Panisingan ka tagse sabeka kanta te katuenan te pegpeila ne due ka Panisingan, su eyew egpakabulig ki te duma ta. 8 Ka senge-etew, egbehayan te Panisingan te pegpasabut te kaalam te Manama, ne ka sabeka, egbehayan degma te sikan ded ne Panisingan te manedted ne katuenan te pegpanulu. 9 Ka senge-etew, egbehayan te sikan ded ne Panisingan te dakel ne pegpalintutuu, ne ka sabeka, egbehayan te sikan ded ne Panisingan te pegpamawi. 10 Senge-etew, egbehayan te peggimu te me kein-inuwan, ka sabeka sika se pegpangguhud te impanengneng te Manama, ne ka sabeka sika se peg-ila te me panisingan, ka sabeka sika se peglalag te lein ne me linalahan, ne ka sabeka, sika se pegsabut te lein ne linalahan. 11 Sika se langun, himu te sabeka re wey sikan ded ne Panisingan. Egpamehayan din ka tagse sabeka te katuenan sumale te kandin ne pegbuut.

4 [xr]There are various classes of skill(s)/knowledge that God gives to the believers, but that Spirit only is the source of them. 5 There are also various ways of our(incl) serving, but that Lord only is who_ we(incl) _serve. 6 And there are also various things_that_ God _gets_ us(incl) _to_do, but that God only is the (one who) helps us(incl) all to do them. 7 Each one of us(incl) has been_given skill/knowledge by the Spirit for recognizing that the Spirit is there, so_that we(incl) can_help our(incl) companion(s). 8 One person, is given understanding of the wisdom of God by the Spirit, and one, is also given effective skill at teaching by that same Spirit. 9 One person, is given big faith/believing by that same Spirit, and one, is given ability_to_heal by that same Spirit. 10 One person, is given the making of wonders, one that telling what God has made known, one that recognizing spirits, one that speaking in other languages, and one, that understanding other language(s). 11 Those all, are done by just a single and that same Spirit. He distributes skill(s)/knowledge to each one according to his will.

Sabeka re ka lawa ta piru masalig ne baad

The body is just one but many pieces

12 [xr]Ka lawa ta, masalig ne baad. Ne minsan ke masalig ne baad, piru sabeka re iya sika ne lawa. Ne iling naan ded degma si Kristu wey seeye se migpalintutuu kandin. 13 Su sikanta langun, Hudiyu ma wey se kene, uripen ma wey se kene, nabewutismuwan kid eyew egkeyimu ne sabeka ne lawa pinaahi te sabeka ne Panisingan te Manama, ne sika ne Panisingan ka narawat ta langun.[fn]

12 [xr]Our(incl) body, (has) many pieces. And even_though there are many pieces, but the body is really just one. And Christ and those who believe (in) him are really just the same. 13 Because we(incl) all, Hudiyu or not, slave or not, we(incl) were baptized in_order_to become one body by_means_of one Spirit of God, and that Spirit is the (one who) is received by all.[fn]

14 Su ka lawa, kene ne sabeka re ne baad su masalig. 15 Panunggiling ke egkahi ka paa, “Kena a ne baad te lawa su kena a ne belad,” piru baad pad iya sikandin te lawa minsan egkahi sikandin te iling due. 16 Ne panunggiling ke egkahi degma ka talinga, “Puun su kene e ma ne mata, kena a ne baad te lawa,” piru baad pad iya sikandin te lawa minsan egkahi sikandin te iling due. 17 Panunggiling ke neelin naan de ne mata ka intiru ne lawa, egmenuwen naan e te pegdineg? Wey ke senge-talingaan naan de ka sabeka ne lawa, egmenuwen naan e te peggarek te nekey re iya? 18 Piru kene ne iling due, su intahu te Manama ka nalein-lein ne baad te lawa ta diye te natahuan dan sumale te pegbuut din. 19 Kenad e egkangaranan ne lawa ke sabeka re ne baad. 20 Su ka malehet, masalig iya ne baad, piru sabeka re ne lawa.

14 Because the body, is not just one part because (it's) many. 15 For_example if the leg/foot says, “I am not a part of the body because I am not a arm/hand,” but it's still really a part of the body even if it says (things) like that. 16 And for_example if the ear also says, “Because I am not an eye, I am not a part of the body,” but it's still really a part of the body even if it says (things) like that. 17 For_example if the entire body was just an eye(s), how would it hear? And if the body was just one ear, how would it smell anything? 18 But it's not like that, because God put the various parts in our(incl) body in their place(s) according to his will. 19 Just a single part can't be called a body. 20 Because the truth is, (there are) indeed many parts, but just one body.

21 Ka mata, kene egpakakahi diye te belad, “Kene ku egkeilanganen sikeykew!” Kene degma egpakakahi ka ulu diye te paa, “Kene ku egkeilanganen sikeykew!” 22 Kunaleg te sika se me baad te lawa ne egkahiyen ta ne mahuye wey kene ne impurtanti, iyan bes amana egkeilangana. 23 Ne seeye se me baad te lawa ne in-isip ta ne ware amana karuan, nasi ne iyan ta amana egtangguwen. Ne seeye se me baad te lawa ne kene perem ne meupiya ne egtengtengan, nasi ne iyan ta eg-ay-ayaran te egpakumbale. 24 Piru seeye se me meupiya ne baad te lawa ta, kene ne keilangan ne egtangguwen te iling due. Piru inggimu te Manama ka lawa ta eyew egkabehayan te dakel ne bantug ka baad te lawa ne bayew kene perem ne impurtanti 25 su eyew kene egkabaad-baad, ke kene, egpegtangtangguwey sikandan. 26 Emun ke egmasakit ka sabeka ne baad, egmasakit iya ka langun, ne emun ke egdeyrayen ka sabeka, egkahale sikandan langun.

21 The eye, can't say to the arm/hand, “I don't need you(sg)!” The head also can't say to the leg/foot, “I don't need you(sg)!” 22 However those parts of the body that we(incl) call weak and not important, they are what (we) [surprise] greatly need. 23 And those parts of the body that we(incl) consider having no great purpose, despite_that we(incl) greatly look_after (them). And those parts of the body that are not really good for looking_at, despite_that we(incl) carefully clothe (them). 24 But those good parts of our(incl) body, don't need to be looked_after like that. But God made our(incl) body(s) so_that the part(s) of the body that would not be somewhat important can be looked_after 25 so_that (they) are_ not _split_up, but rather, they look_after_each_other. 26 If one part is hurting, indeed it all hurts, and if one (part) is praised, they are all happy.

27 Ne seini ka kaluwasan kayi: sikanta se migpalintutuu, iyan ta egkeilingan ka lawa ni Kristu, ne ka tagse naa sabeka kanta, me baad ki te sika ne lawa. 28 [xr]Ne ka sika ne lawa ni Kristu, nalein-lein ka impeyimu te Manama. Ka an-anayan ne in-alam te Manama, sika se me apustulis, ka igkarangeb sika se me prupita, ne ka igkatelu sika se me talagpanulu, nataman, sikan e se me talaggimu te me kein-inuwan, ka me talagbawi, ka me talagbulig, ka me talagpangulu te langun-langun de, wey talaglalag te lein ne me linalahan. 29 Langun te naa ne me apustulis? Langun naa ne me prupita? Langun naa ne me talagpanulu? Langun naa ne eggimu te me kein-inuwan? 30 Langun naa ne imbehayan te pegpamawi? Langun naa ne egpakalalag te lein ne me linalahan? Langun naa ne egpakapasabut ke nekey ka kaluwasan te sika se lein ne me linalahan?

27 And this is the meaning here: we(incl) who believe, we(incl) are_like the body of Christ, and each one of us(incl), we(incl) are parts of that body. 28 [xr]And that body of Christ, God gets_it_to_do various (things). The first (ones) that were_chosen by God, were those apostles, secondly those prophets, thirdly those teachers, then, those who do amazing_things, healers, helpers, teachers of just everything, and speakers of other languages. 29 Are we(incl) all apostles? All prophets? All teachers? All doing amazing_things? 30 All given healing_ability? All able_to_speak languages not understood? All able_to_understand what the meaning is of those other languages?

31 Sikan naa, keilangan ne iyan niyu ikabagget ka subla pad ne impurtanti ne me katuenan.

31 So then, it's_necessary that what you(pl) encourage (are) the most important skills/knowledge.

Ne kuntee igpanulu ku kaniyu ka subla pad ne meupiya te langun.

And now I will_teach you(pl) what is even better than all.

Ka geyinawa

Love

131 Minsan ke egpakalalag a te egkalein-lein ne linalahan te me etew wey te me panalihan, piru ke ware geyinawa ku diye te duma, egpekeiling e re te ahung ne mahulub wey ke putew ne basalan ne egtetahingting. 2 [xr]Ne minsan ke egpakapanagne a, wey egpakasabut a te langun ne neeles de wey ke egkateu a te langun, wey minsan ke due pegpalintutuu ku ne egpakapaalin te me bubungan, piru ke ware geyinawa ku diye te duma, ware iya pulus ku. 3 Ne emun ke igpamehey kud e ka langun ne keddiey, wey minsan pad ke igtuhut ku ne egtutungen ka lawa ku, piru ke ware geyinawa ku diye te duma, ware iya egkaangey ku te sika ne eggimuwen ku.

131 Even if I can_speak in the various languages of people and of angels, but I have_no love for other(s), I am just like a noisy gong or like iron that is beaten and tinkles. 2 [xr]And even if I can_prophesy, and I can_understand all that is just hidden or if I know everything, and even if I have faith to_be_able_to_move mountains, but if I have_no love for other(s), I really have_no value. 3 And if I distribute everything that's mine, and even if I permit that my body is burned, but if I have_no love for other(s), I really won't gain anything by my doing that.

4 Ka etew ne geheyinaween te duma, mapariralemen, meupiya diye te duma, kene ne iimmeen, kene ne mapegpeggasal wey kene ne hambuhen. 5 Ka etew ne geheyinaween te duma, kene ne egkasen, kene ne leheren, kene ne mahaan egkabelu, wey mahaan de egkalingew ke due egpakatameneng kandin, 6 kene egkahale te mareet, ke kene, iyan de igkahale ka maheteng. 7 Ka etew ne geheyinaween te duma, egpakaantus te langun, layun egpalintutuu wey egpallateng, wey egpabulus-bulus te langun-langun de.

4 The person who is loving to other(s), is humble, good to other(s), not envious, not boasting and not proud. 5 The person who is loving to other(s), is not vulgar, not stingy, not quick to anger, quickly just forgets if there_is (someone who) upsets him/her, 6 is not happy with/at bad (things/actions), but rather, what_makes_(him/her)_happy is sensible (things/actions). 7 The person who is loving to other(s), endures everything, always believes and hopes, and repeatedly_continues in just everything.

8 Ka geyinawa, ware iya egtamanan. Piru ka pegpanagne wey ka katuenan, eglihad de, ne ka peglalag te lein ne me linalahan, egkaawe ded. 9 Su ka katuenan ta wey ka pegpangguhud ta te impanengneng te Manama, duen pad seyyup. 10 Piru ke eggingume e sika se warad e seyyup, egkaawe e sika se duen pad seyyup.

8 Love, indeed has no ending. But prophesying and knowledge/skill(s), will_ just _pass_by, and speaking in other language(s), will_be_removed. 9 Because our(incl) skill(s)/knowledge and our(incl) telling what God has made known, still has fault(s). 10 But if/when that without fault(s) arrives, that which still has fault(s) will_leave.

11 Te bate e pad, binate pad iya ka peglalag-lalag ku, ka suman-suman ku, wey ka pegpangatarengan ku. Piru te mayansan ad e, kena ad e egbibinate. 12 Ka egkakita ta kuntee, egpekeiling de te kene amana egkamelmelehan ne ulaula diye te alungan, piru egginguma ka aldew ne egkamelmelehan e ka langun. Baad de ka natahaan ku kuntee, piru egginguma ka aldew ne egkatahaan kud e ka langun iling te pegkataheyi te Manama keddiey.

11 When still a child, my speaking, my thinking, and my arguments were still childish. But when I was mature, I didn't do_childish_things. 12 What_ we(incl) _can_see now/today, is_ just _like a face not very clear in a mirror, but the day will_come that everything will_be_clear. What I know now is just a portion, but the day will_come when I will_know everything like God knows about me.

13 Purisu kene egkaawe seini se tatelu: pegpalintutuu, pegpallateng, wey ka peggeyinawa. Piru ka subla ne labew te langun, sika se peggeyinawa.

13 Therefore these three can't be removed: believing, hoping, and loving. But the very_much greater than all, is that loving.

Ka pegpanagne wey peglalag te lein ne linalahan

The prophesying and speaking in other languages

141 Pakannekali niyu ka peggeyinawa te duma, wey mapahetpeta niyu man-e te pegpakannekal ne egpakarawat kew te katuenan ne igbehey te Panisingan te Manama labi en iya ka pegpangguhud te impanengneng te Manama. 2 Su ka etew ne eglalag te lein ne linalahan, kene ne etew ka eglalahan din, ke kene, ka Manama su ware etew ne egpakasabut te eglalahen din. Iglalag din pinaahi te Panisingan ka neeles de ne me lalag ne ware nataheyi te duma. 3 Piru sika se egpanagne, iyan din mule eglalahan ka me etew eyew te peggehet te pegpalintutuu ran, pegpeyibahet kandan, wey peg-imu-imu kandan. 4 Ka etew ne eglalag te lein ne linalahan, kandin de ne pegkeetew ka eglig-enen din. Piru ka etew ne egpanagne, eglig-en te langun ne migmalintutuu.

141 Strive(pl) in loving other(s), and also energetically(pl) strive that you(pl) can_receive the skill/knowledge that the Spirit of God will_give especially that telling what God has made known. 2 Because the person who speaks in other languages, it's not a person he/she is speaking_to, but rather, God because no person can_understand what_ he/she _is_saying. He speaks by_means of the Spirit a hidden/secret message that's not understood by other(s). 3 But the (one who) prophesies, he/she's speaking_to the people on_the_contrary in_order to strengthen their believing/faith, encouraging them, and comforting them. 4 The person who speaks in another language, only his self is strengthened by him. But the person who prophesies, strengthens all the believers.

5 Egkeupian a perem ne egpakalalag kew langun te lein ne linalahan, piru iyan ku subla igkeupii ne egpakapangguhud kew te impanengneng te Manama. Su seeye se egpanagne, labew pad te seeye se eglalag te lein ne linalahan, gawas ke due egpakaluwas te eglalahen din su eyew egkalig-en ka langun ne migmalintutuu. 6 Na, me suled, ke eggenduen a te kaniyu ne eglalag te lein ne linalahan, nekey ma ka egkaangey niyu? Ware iya, gawas ke due igkalalag ku kaniyu ne impataha te Manama, wey ke katuenan naa, wey ke pegpangguhud naa te impanengneng te Manama, wey ke pegpanulu naa.

5 I wish that you(pl) all were able_to_speak in other language(s), but what_ I _would really like is that you(pl) could_tell what God has made known. Because those who prophesy, are above (in status) those who speak in other language(s), unless there's (someone) able_to_interpret what_ he/she _says so_that all the believers could be strengthened. 6 Now_then, friends/cousins, if I go_there to you(pl) and speak other language(s), what will you(pl) gain? Nothing indeed, unless I speak to you(pl) what God has revealed to me, or knowledge, or telling what God has made known, or teaching.

7 Sumsumana niyu seeye se eggamiten te peg-ulahing ne ware umul, iling te pulendag wey alpa. Ke due egparahing due piru kene egkateu ke egmenuwen, kene egkatahaan te me duma rin ke nekey ka igparahing din. 8 Panunggilingan degma te trumpita ne eggamiten te me sundalu, ke kene ne klaru ka dahing din, egmenuwen te sundalu te pegpangandam te pegbubunu? 9 Ne iling naan ded degma kaniyu. Emun ke eglalag kew te lein ne linalahan, egmenuwen te pegsabut te seeye se egpammineg? Henduen de te migpakiglalag kew diye te kalamag. 10 Masalig iya ka nalein-lein ne linalahan kayi te ampew te tane, ne langun ne linalahan, due igpasabut. 11 Piru ke kene ku egkasabut ka eglalahen te etew, eg-isipen ku sikandin ne lapu de, ne sikeddi degma lapu e re diye te kandin. 12 Ne iling naan ded degma kaniyu. Puun su amana kew egkabagget ne egpakakuwa te katuenan ne egpuun te Panisingan, pakannekali niyu ne egkarawat niyu ka me katuenan ne egpakalig-en te migmalintutuu.

7 Consider(pl) those (things) used for singing that have_no life, like a flute or a harp. If (someone) sounds them but doesn't know how, his/her companions won't_know what his/her sound is. 8 For_example also a trumpet that is used by soldiers, if its sound is not clear, how will the soldier(s) prepare for fighting? 9 And it's also just like that with you(pl). If you(pl) speak in other language(s), how will those_listening understand? It's just as if you(pl) spoke into the wind. 10 There are indeed many different languages here on top of the earth, and each language, there_is something_meant. 11 But if I can't understand what a person is_saying, I consider that he/she's just a foreigner, and I am also a foreigner to him/her. 12 And it's also just like that with you(pl). Because you(pl) are very enthusiastic to get skill/knowledge from the Spirit, strive(pl) that you(pl) can_receive the skills/knowledge that can_strengthen the believers.

13 Purisu, seeye se eglalag te lein ne linalahan, keilangan ne eg-ampu ne egbehayan degma sikandin te katuenan te pegpasabut ke nekey ka eglalahen din. 14 Su emun ke eg-ampu a te lein ne linalahan, iyan de eg-ampu ka panisingan ku, piru ka suman-suman ku ware nakasabut. 15 Na, nekey naa ka eggimuwen ku? Iling kayi ka eggimuwen ku, eg-ampu a te igpaampu keddi te panisingan ku, wey eg-ampu a man-e te sika se egkasabut ku ne lalag. Eg-ulahing a te igpeulahing keddi te panisingan ku, wey eg-ulahing a man-e te egkasabut ku ne lalag. 16 Su emun ke egdeyrey ka te Manama ne iyan nu eggamiten ka igpalalag te panisingan, egmenuwen te duma te pegluyud te pegpasalamat nu ke kene sikandan egpakasabut te eglalahen nu? 17 Su minsan pad ke meupiye e ka pegpasalamat nu te Manama, piru kene seini egpakabagget te duma.

13 Therefore, the (ones) who speaks other language(s), needs to pray that he/she will_ also _be_given skill/knowledge for understanding what_ he/she _said. 14 Because if/when I pray in other language(s), it's just my spirit that prays, but my mind doesn't understand. 15 Now then, what shall I do? This is what I'll do, I'll pray what_ my spirit _causes_ me _to_pray, and I also pray with that speech that I can_understand. I will_sing what_ my spirit _causes_ me _to_sing, and I also sing with speech that I can_understand. 16 Because if you(sg) praise God and what_ you(sg) _use is what_ the spirit _causes_(you)_to_say, how can other(s) include you(sg) in giving_thanks if they don't understand what_ you(sg) _are_saying? 17 Because even if your(sg) thanking God is good, but (it) can't_encourage other(s).

18 Egpasalamat a te Manama ne malasi a egpakalalag te lein ne linalahan kuntere kaniyu langun. 19 Piru ke diya a te libulunganan te migmalintutuu, egmeupiyeen ku pad ke eglalag e re te lalimma ne egkasabut ne lalag eyew te pegpanulu te duma, du te eglalag a te lein ne linalahan ne me sapulu ne libu (10,000).

18 I thank God that I (more) often can_speak in other language(s) compared with you(pl) all. 19 But if I (am) there at a meeting of believers, I prefer if I speak just five words that can_be_understood in_order for teaching other(s), compared_with (if) I speaking ten thousand (10,000) in another language.

20 Me suled, kene niyu ilinga te bate ka pegsuman-suman niyu meyitenged due. Ke meyitenged te mareet, henduen pad ne pabate-bate kew, piru pabuyag-buyag kew ke meyitenged te pegsuman-suman niyu. 21 [xr]Nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne miggenendue:

20 Friends/cousins, don't imitate a child in your(pl) thinking about that. If it's about bad (things), then you(pl) can be_like_children, but be_mature(pl) concerning your(pl) thinking. 21 [xr]It's written in the Writings that go:

“Egpakiglalag a te keet-etawan ku, kahi te Magbebaye ne Manama,

“I will_speak to my people, says the Lord God,

pinaahi te lein ne linalahan ne linalahan te me lapu,

by_means of other language(s) which_are language(s) of foreigners,

piru kene iya sikandan egpammineg keddiey.”

but they will certainly not listen to me.”

22 Na, ka peglalag te lein ne linalahan sabeka sika ne palinneu, piru kene ne para te migmalintutuu, ke kene, para te ware migpalintutuu. Ne ka pegpangguhud te impanengneng te Manama, para sika te migmalintutuu, kene ne para te ware migpalintutuu.

22 Now_then, the speaking of other language(s) is one sign, but not for the believers, but rather, for (those who) don't believe. And the telling of what God has made known, that's for believers, not for (those who) don't believe.

23 Purisu, emun ke eglibulung kew te pegsimba wey eglalag kew langun te lein ne linalahan, ne due egseled diye te kaniyu ne ware migpalintutuu wey ke etew naa ne ware nakataha ke nekey ka eggimuwen niyu, egpakakahi sikandin te egbusawen kew e. 24 Piru ke egpangguhud kew langun te impanengneng te Manama, ne ka egseled diye te kaniyu ne ware migpalintutuu wey ke etew naa ne ware nakataha ke nekey ka eggimuwen niyu, eg-ila sikandin ne makasesale din, wey eggukuman sikandin te kunsinsya rin tenged te langun ne egkarineg din. 25 Ne pinaahi rue, ke nekey ka inneeles din diye te pusung din, egkatahaan. Ne egkataman, egpanimbuel sikandin ne egbebakbak ka egsimba te Manama wey egkahi, “Kayi iya te kaniyu ka Manama.”

23 Therefore, if/when you(pl) gather for worshiping and you(pl) all speak in other language(s), and there_is (someone who) enters (among) you(pl) who doesn't believe or a person who doesn't know what you(pl) are_doing, he/she will_say that you(pl) are crazy. 24 But if you(pl) all tell what God has made known, and (someone who) doesn't believe enters (among) you(pl) or a person who doesn't know what you(pl) are_doing, he/she will_recognize that he/she is a sinner, and he/she will_be_judged by his/her conscience due to all the he/she hears. 25 And by means of that, whatever is hidden in his/her heart, will_be_known. And finally, he/she will_kneel and prostrate worshiping God and say, “God is indeed here with you(pl).”

Ka eleg ne paahi te pegsimba

The correct/true way of worshiping

26 Seini ka igpasabut ku due me suled, emun ke eglibulung kew, due sabeka ne eg-ulahing, due egpanulu, due egpanengneng ke nekey ka impataha kandin te Manama, due eglalag te lein ne linalahan, wey due degma egpasabut ke nekey sika se inlalag te sika ne etew. Keilangan ne egkeyimu niyu sika se langun eyew te peglig-en te migmalintutuu. 27 Ke duen ma eglalag te lein ne linalahan, keilangan ne daruwa re wey ke tatelu re ka eglalag, piru kene egpalegseey, wey keilangan ne due lein ne etew ne egpasabut due. 28 Piru ke ware egpakasabut due, keilangan ne egpeeneng-eneng naan de sikandan diye te libulunganan, wey iyan naan de eglalahan ka kandan ne pegkeetew wey ka Manama. 29 Ke duen ma egpanagne, keilangan ne daruwa re wey ke tatelu ka eglalag. Ne ka duma ne etew ka egsuman-suman eg-ayad-ayad ke malehet naa ka intagne. 30 Piru ke due egpanagne, wey due sabeka ne migpinnuu dutu ne nakarawat te igpataha te Manama, keilangan ne egpeeneng-eneng e ka miglalag. 31 Su egkaayun ne egpasubsubaley kew langun ka egpangguhud te impanengneng te Manama, su eyew egkapanulu kew wey egkabagget kew langun. 32 Ka etew ne egpanagne, egpakatigkel ke nekey ka eglalahen din. 33 Su ka Manama, kene ne Manama sikandin te kasamuk, ke kene, te keupianan.

26 This is what_ I _want to explain there friends/cousins, if/when you(pl) gather, there_will_be one who sings, who teaches, who makes known what God revealed to him/her, who speaks in another language, and who also explains what was spoken by that person. It's_necessary that you(pl) do all that in_order_for strengthening the believers. 27 If there_is (one who) speaks in other language(s), it's_necessary for just two or just three to speak, but not simultaneously, and it's_necessary that there_is a different person to explain that. 28 But if no (one) can_understand that, it's_necessary that they just keep_silent in the meeting, and just what's spoken_to is their own selves and God. 29 If there's (someone who) prophesies, it's_necessary that there's just two or three that speak. And the other people carefully consider if what_as_prophesied is correct/true. 30 But if there's (someone who) prophesies, and there_is one who sits there who receives what_ God _will_reveal, it's_necessary that (the one) speaking be_silent. 31 Because it's_possible that you(pl) all take_turns to tell what_ God _made_known, so_that you(pl) will_be_taught and that you(pl) all are encouraged. 32 The person who prophesies, is able_to_control what_ he/she _says. 33 Because God, he is not a God of disturbance, but rather, of well-being/peace.

Ne sumale te nabatasan te langun ne punduk te keet-etawan te Manama,34 ka me malitan, keilangan ne egpeeneng-eneng de diye te seled te libulunganan. Ware tuhuti sikandan ne eglalag, piru keilangan ne egparuma-ruma sikandan sumale te nasulat diye te Balaud ni Muwisis. 35 Ne emun ke due igkeupii ran te eg-ugsi-ugsi, keilangan ne diyad e te baley sikandan eg-inse te asawa ran. Su mekeyilew-hilew te malitan ke eglalag diye te libulunganan.

And according to the custom of all groups of the people of God,34 women, it's_necessary that (they) are just silent inside the meeting_place. They are_ not _permitted to speak, but they need to comply according to what_is_written in the Law of Moses. 35 And if they want to investigate, it's_necessary that there at the house they ask their spouse(s). Because it's shameful for a woman if (she) speaks at the meeting_place.

36 Sikaniyu iya! Kahiyen niyu buwa ne duen de egpuun te kaniyu ka lalag te Manama? Wey ke kahiyen niyu buwa ne sikaniyu re ka nakarawat due? 37 Ke due sabeka ne egsuman-suman ne prupita sikandin wey ke imbehayan naa te katuenan te panisingan, keilangan ne eg-ileen din iya ne ka insulat ku kaniyu, suhu te Magbebaye. 38 Ke due etew ne kene eg-angken kayi, kene degma eg-angkenen sikandin.

36 You(pl) indeed! Maybe you(pl) thought that the word of God just comes from you(pl)? And maybe you(pl) thought that only you(pl) received that? 37 If there_is one who thinks/considers that he/she is a prophet or has been_given a spirit of wisdom/skill, he/she needs to recognize indeed what_ I _wrote to you(pl), the command of the Lord. 38 If there_is a person who doesn't accept this, he/she also won't be accepted.

39 Sikan naa me suled ku, pakannekali niyu iya ne egpakapangguhud kew te impanengneng te Manama, wey kene niyu balabahi ka peglalag te lein ne linalahan. 40 Piru keilangan ne eggimuwen niyu ka langun te meupiya wey eleg ne paahi.

39 So then my friends/cousins, strive(pl) indeed to tell what God has made known, and don't block the speaking in other language(s). 40 But it's_necessary that you(pl) do everything in the good and true/correct way.

Ka peg-uyag ki Kristu

The bringing_to_life of Christ

151 Ne kuntee me suled, egkeupian a ne egpasuman-suman kaniyu meyitenged te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne inwali ku due te kaniyu, ne narawat niyu wey nasasindehan te pegpalintutuu niyu. 2 Egkaluwas kew pinaahi te sika ne Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne inwali ku kaniyu ke egpabulus kew egpalintutuu due. Piru ke kene, egkeyimu ne ware karuan te pegpalintutuu niyu.

151 And now/today friends/cousins, I want to remind you(pl) about the Good Report that I preached to you(pl), and that_ you(pl) _received and stood_ your(pl) believing _on. 2 You(pl) are_saved by that Good Report that I preached to you(pl) if you(pl) continue to believe it. But if not, you(pl) believing/faith will_become of no purpose.

3 [xr]Ne seini ka labew te langun ne impanulu keddiey ne igpanulu ku degma kaniyu: namatey si Kristu eyew egkapasaylu ka me sale ta sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan. 4 [xr]Inlebeng sikandin wey in-uyag te igkatelu ne aldew sumale degma te nasulat te Kasulatan. 5 [xra][xrb]Ne migpakita sikandin ki Pidru, nataman diyad e man-e te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne me hibateen din. 6 Pegkapenga dutu, migpakite e man-e sikandin diye te miglibulung ne migmalintutuu ne subla te lalimma ne libu (5,000). Nammatey e kuntee ka duma kandan piru neuyag pad mule ka kasuluhan. 7 Pegkapenga dutu, migpakite e degma sikandin diye te ki Santiyagu, nataman, diyad e degma te langun ne apustulis.

3 [xr]And this is above all that_was_taught to me that I also taught to you(pl): Christ died so_that our(incl) sins can_be_forgiven according to what_is_written in the Writings. 4 [xr]He was_buried and brought_to_life on the third day according also to what_is_written in the Writings. 5 [xra][xrb]And he showed (himself) to Pidru, then again to his twelve (12) disciples. 6 When that was_finished, he showed (himself) again to the gathered believers who were more than five thousand (5,000). Some of them have died now but most of them are still alive on_the_contrary. 7 After that, he also showed (himself) to Santiyagu, then, there also to all of the apostle(s).

8 [xr]Te katammanan, migpakite e degma sikandin keddiey, minsan ke nekeiling a te bate ne miglesut te kene ne eleg ne timpu. 9 [xr]Inlalag ku sika tenged su sikeddiey ka kene amana ne impurtanti te me apustulis. Kena a ne eleg ne egngaranan te apustulis tenged su migpamaybayaran ku dengan ka migmalintutuu te Manama. 10 Piru pinaahi te keyid-u te Manama keddiey, neyimu a kuntee ne iling kayi, wey napulusan iya ka keyid-u rin keddiey. Ka malehet, labew ka keddiey ne peglasey-lasey du te duma ku ne me apustulis, piru kene ne puun sika te pegpakannekal ku, ke kene, puun te bulig te Manama keddiey. 11 Piru ware kaleinan ke sikeddi wey ke sikandan ka migwali, su nekeg-iling de ka inwali ney, wey sika ka impalintutuuwan niyu.

8 [xr]Finally, he also showed (himself) to me, even though I was like a child that was_born at the not correct time. 9 [xr]I said that because I (am) the not very important apostle. I am not worthy to be called an apostle because before I repeatedly_persecuted the believers of God. 10 But by_means of the pity of God to me, I now became like this, and his pity for me was indeed valuable. The truth, is that my laboring was greater than my companion apostles, but that wasn't from my striving, but rather, from the help of God to me. 11 But there's_no difference if it's me or them that preach, because what_ we(excl) _preach is just the same, and that's what_ you(pl) _believed.

Ka peg-uyag te minatey

The bringing_to_life of the dead

12 Na, ka inwali ney kaniyu, sika se peg-uyag ki Kristu, ne mania te due duma due te kaniyu ne egkahi ne kene eg-uyahen ka me minatey? 13 Piru ke malehet ma sika, ware degma uyaha si Kristu. 14 Ne emun ke ware uyaha si Kristu, ware perem karuan te inwali ney, wey ware degma karuan te pegpalintutuu niyu. 15 Ke iling ma rue, nekeuubat key e meyitenged te Manama, su impamalehet ney ne in-uyag din si Kristu. Piru egkeyimu sika ne ubat ke kene eg-uyahen ka me minatey. 16 Piru emun ke kene ne malehet ne eg-uyahen te Manama ka me minatey, kene degma ne malehet ne in-uyag din si Kristu. 17 Ke ware uyaha si Kristu, ware karuan te pegpalintutuu niyu, wey ware pad napasaylu ka me sale niyu. 18 Ne seeye se migpatey e ne migpalintutuu ki Kristu, ware bes naluwas, ke kene, nareetan bes ded. 19 Emun ke kayi re te ampew te tane egkataman ka egpallatengen ta diye ki Kristu, sikanta iya ka subla ne mekeyid-u-hid-u te langun ne etew.

12 Now_then, what_ I _preached to you(pl), was that bringing_to_life of Christ, so why are there some of you(pl) that say the dead are_ not _brought_to_life? 13 But if that is correct/true, Christ also wasn't brought_to_life. 14 And if Christ wasn't brought_to_life, there's_no real use in what_ we(excl) _preached, and also there's_no use in your(pl) believing/faith. 15 If it's like that, we(excl) lied concerning God, because we(excl) witnessed that he brought_ Christ _to_life. But that becomes a lie if the dead aren't brought_to_life. 16 But if it's not correct that God brings_ the dead _to_life, it's also not correct that he brought_ Christ _to_life. 17 If Christ wasn't brought_to_life, there's_no purpose to your(pl) believing, and your(pl) sins are_ not yet _forgiven. 18 And those that died who believed (in) Christ, were not [surprise] saved, but rather, were_ just _destroyed [surprise]. 19 If our(incl) hope in Christ just ends here on top of the earth, we(incl) indeed (are) the greatly pitied of all people.

20 Piru ka malehet, si Kristu ka hun-a ne neuyag puun te kamatayen, ne puun due, egpakanengneng ki ne eg-uyahen iya te Manama ka langun ne egpatey. 21 Su iyan migpuunan ne migpatey ka langun ne etew, tenged te inggimu te sabeka ne etew ne si Adan. Ne iling ded degma ka peg-uyag te me minatey, tenged ded degma sika te sabeka ne etew ne si Kristu. 22 Su ka langun ne etew, egpatey iya tenged su kabuhalan sikandan ni Adan. Ne iling ded degma, ka langun ne nasabeke e ki Kristu, eg-uyahen. 23 Piru ka peg-uyag, due eleg ne paahi: si Kristu ka nekewun-a ne neuyag. Ne emun ke eglibed e sikandin kayi te kalibutan, egkeuyag e degma seeye se migpatey e ne me sakup din. 24 Egkataman, eggingume e ka katammanan te timpu. Ne emun ke egkatalu e ni Kristu ka me kuntere din ne due me katenged wey ke geem naa te pegmandu, igbehey rin ka Peghari diye te Manama ne Amey. 25 [xr]Su keilangan ne eghari si Kristu taman te eggimuwen din ne diekanan din ka me kuntere din. 26 Ka katammanan ne kuntere ne keilangan ne egdereetan, sika se kamatayen. 27 [xr]Su nasulat te Kasulatan, “Inggimu te Manama ka langun ne egparuma-ruma kandin.” Klaru ne ka “langun” ware labet te Manama mismu ne iyan miggimu te langun eyew egparuma-ruma ki Kristu. 28 Emun ke egparuma-rume e ki Kristu ka langun, ne sikandin degma se Anak mismu egparuma-rume e diye te Manama ne iyan miggimu te langun ne egparuma-ruma ki Kristu. Ne ka Maname e ka egmandu te langun-langun de iya.

20 But the truth, is that Christ was the first raised_to_life from death, and from that, we(incl) can know that God will_ indeed _raise_to_life all who die. 21 Because the reason the all people die, is due to what the one person Adan did. And like that also is the coming_to_life of the dead, due also just to one person that is Christ. 22 Because all people, indeed die because they are descendants of Adan. And just like that also, all who are_united in/with Christ, will_be_brought_to_life. 23 But the bringing_to_life, there_is a correct way: Christ is the first that came_to_life. And when he returns here to the world, those followers of his who have already died will_ also _come_to_life. 24 Then, the end of time will_come. And when Christ wins over his enemies who have authority and power for ruling, he will_give the Reigning to God the Father. 25 [xr]Because it's_necessary for Christ to reign until he makes his enemies something_to_stand_on. 26 The final enemy that needs to be ruined, is that death. 27 [xr]Because it's written in the Writings, “God made all to comply with him.” It's clear that “all” doesn't include God himself who made all in_order_to comply with Christ. 28 If/When all complies with Christ, he himself the Child complies with God who made all that complies with Christ. And God is the (one who) commands absolutely everything.

29 Na, meyitenged man-e te peg-uyag, ke kene ma egkeuyag ka me minatey, nekey naan e ka karuan te seeye se egmabewutismu para kandan? Mani buwa te egbewutismuwan sikandan para te me minatey ke kene ma eg-uyahen? 30 Ne sikanami, mania te uras-uras ne nakatahu key te karereetan? 31 Me suled, ke nekey kamalehet ka kahale ku te pegsabeka niyu ki Kristu Hisus ne Magbebaye ta, iling degma kamalehet due ka egkatangke ku ne kamatayen tagse aldew. 32 [xr]Emun ke eg-etew-etawen ku re te eglalag, nekey ma ka egkaangey ku ke egpakig-ehet a te me etew kayi te Ipisu ne egpekeiling te mabbulut ne mahintalunan? Purisu ke kene ma eg-uyahen ka me minatey, meupiya pad ke eg-ikul ki te lalahen ne miggenendue, “Egkeen ki wey eg-inum ki, su kaaselem, egpamatey kid.”

29 Now_then, about bringing_alive again, if the dead don't come_alive, what's the point/value of those who get baptized for them? Why would they be baptized for the dead if they aren't brought_to_life? 30 And we(excl), why are we(excl) hourly put in danger? 31 Cousins/siblings, how true my joy is at your(pl) uniting in Christ Jesus our(incl) Lord, the death that I face every day is also true like that. 32 [xr]If/when I just speak as_a_person, what can_ I _gain if I conflict with the people here in Ephesus that are_like fierce wild_animal(s)? Therefore if the dead are_ not _raised_to_life, it would_be better if we(incl) follow the saying that goes, “We(incl) eat and we(incl) drink, because tomorrow, we(incl) will_die.”

33 Kene kew palimbung, su due lalahen ne miggenendue, “Egpakarereet te meupiya ne batasan ka egduma-ruma te mareet ne me etew.” 34 Mahetenga niyud e te egsuman-suman wey kene kew e himu te sale. Due duma kaniyu ne ware nekeila te Manama—inlalag ku seini te pegpeyilew kaniyu.

33 Don't(pl) be_cheated, because there's a saying that goes, “Accompanying bad people can ruin a good custom/character.” 34 Make_ your(pl) thinking _sensible and don't(pl) do sin. There are some of you(pl) who don't know God—I say this for shaming you(pl).

Ka lawa te etew ne egkeuyag man-e

The body of people that come_alive again

35 Piru ke due eg-inse, “Egmenuwen ma te eg-uyag ka me minatey? Mamenu e ka lawa ran?” 36 Egkeungel iya! Emun ke egpamula ka, kene egtubu ka sika ne beni gawas ke egkamewu pad. 37 Ke egpamula ka, kene ne iyan nu igpamula ka lawa, ke kene, sika iya se beni, ke paley naa, wey ke nekey ka duma ne igpamula nu. 38 Ne tapey e himuwa te Manama ke mamenu ka lawa te sika ne beni wey ka minsan nekey ne beni ne igpamula.

35 But if (someone) asks, “How will the dead be brought_to_life? What_ will their body(s) _be_like?” 36 Foolish indeed! If you(sg) plant, that seed doesn't sprout unless it rots first. 37 If you(sg) plant, it's not the body you(sg) plant, but rather, the seed, if it's rice, or whatever other (things) you(sg) plant. 38 And God previously had created the form of the body of that seed and of whatever seed will_be_planted.

39 Ne iling ded degma, ware nekeg-iling ka lawa te sika se due geyinawa. Lein ka lawa te me etew, lein ka me mananap, lein ka me manuk-manuk, wey nalein-lein degma ka lawa te isda.

39 And like that also, the bodies of those (things that) have life (are) not the same. The body of a person is different, the animals are different, the birds are different, and the body(s) of fish are also varied.

40 Ne due degma nakatahu diye te langit wey due degma kayi te ampew te tane. Ne ka katelesan te seeye se nakatahu diye te langit, ware nekeg-iling te katelesan te me lawa kayi te ampew te tane. 41 Ka aldew, due kandin ne katelesan, lein degma ka katelesan te bulan, wey te me bituen. Ne minsan ka me bituen, lein-lein ka katelesan dan.

40 And there are (things) put there in heaven/sky and there are also here on top of the earth. And the splendor of those things there in heaven/sky, are_ not _like the splendor of bodies here on top of the earth. 41 The sun/day, has his (own) splendor, the splendor of the moon is also different, and of the stars. And even the stars, their splendor is varied.

42 Ne iling naan ded ka peg-uyag te me minatey. Ka lawa ne egkamewu ke iglebeng, piru ke eg-uyahen e te Manama, kenad e sika egkamewu te minsan ken-u. 43 Ke iglebeng ka lawa te minatey, mareet sika ne egtengtengan wey warad kanekal. Piru ke eg-uyahen e man-e, mateles e ne egtengtengan wey manekal e. 44 Peglebeng due, lawa sika te kayi te ampew te tane, piru ke eg-uyahen e, lawe e sika te diye te langit. Ke due lawa kayi te ampew te tane, due degma lawa diye te langit. 45 [xr]Su nasulat e te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Ka an-anayan ne etew ne si Adan, imbehayan te umul.” Piru due egngaranan te katammanan ne Adan, ne iyan si Kristu,[fn] ne iyan egbehey te umul ne ware egtamanan. 46 Piru kene ne iyan egpekewun-a ka lawa ne diye te langit, ke kene, sika se lawa ne kayi te ampew te tane, egkataman, egpakasinundul e ka lawa ne diye te langit. 47 Ka an-anayan ne Adan, kayi migpuun te ampew te tane ne ingkuwa puun te tane. Piru ka igkarangeb ne Adan ne iyan si Kristu, diye migpuun te langit. 48-49 Sikan naa, sikanta se kayi te ampew te tane, nekeiling ka lawa ta te ki Adan ne inggimu puun te tane. Piru keureme, egpekeiling degma ka lawa ta te ki Kristu ne puun te langit.

42 And the coming_to_life_again of the dead is_ just _like that. The body that rots if it's buried, but if brought_to_life by God, it doesn't rot at all (anytime). 43 If the body of a dead (person) is buried, it's awful to look_at and has no more strength. But if brought_to_life again, (it's) good to look_at and strong. 44 (When) it's buried, it's a body from here on top of the earth, but if/when it's brought_to_life, it's a body of there in heaven/sky. If there's a body here on top of the earth, there_is also a body there in heaven/sky. 45 [xr]Because it's_written in the Writings that go, “The first person Adan, was_given life.” But there_is (one) named the final Adan, which is Christ,[fn] who gives life without ending. 46 But the body in heaven/sky can't go_first, but rather, the body here on top of the earth, then, the body in heaven/sky follows. 47 The first Adan, came_from here on top of the earth and was_taken from dirt. But the second Adan who is Christ, came_from heaven/sky. 48-49 So then, we(incl) who (are) here on top of the earth, our(incl) body(s) are_like Adan that was_made from dirt. But in_the_future, our(incl) body(s) will_be_like Christ who is from heaven/sky.

50 Me suled, seini ka igpasabut ku due: ka seini se lawa ta kayi te ampew te tane, kene egpekeugpe diye te Migharian te Manama. Su sika se lawa ne egkamewu, kene egpakaangken te umul ne ware egtamanan.

50 Friends/cousins, this is what_ I _mean by that: this body of ours(incl) here on top of the earth, can't_live in the Reigning_Place of God. Because that body that can_rot, can't accept/receive life without ending.

51 [xr]Pammineg kew! Egguhuran ku sikaniyu te neeles ne planu te Manama: kene ne langun kanta ne egpatey, piru langun ta ne egkabalbalawan se peglelawa. 52 Tigkew re ne egkeyitabu sika, te sabeka re ne pegpele-pele, te timpu ne igparahing e ka katammanan ne trumpita. Su pegdahing te trumpita, eg-uyahen e ka me minatey wey egbehayan e te lawa ne kenad e egkamewu, ne sikanta degma se neuyag pad, egkabalbalawan e ka lawa ta. 53 Su seini se lawa ne egkamewu, keilangan ne egkabalbalawan te lawa ne kenad egkamewu. Ne seini se lawa ne egpatey, keilangan ne egkabalbalawan te lawa ne kenad e egpatey. 54 [xr]Emun ke egkabalbalawan e ka lawa te kenad e egkamewu, wey egkabalbalawan e te kenad e egpatey, egkatuman e ka nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Natalu e ka Kamatayen!”[fn]

51 [xr]Listen(pl)! I will_story you(pl) about the hidden plan of God: we(incl) won't all die, but all of us(incl) will_have (our) bodies changed/replaced. 52 That will_happen suddenly, in just one blink, at the time that the final trumpet sounds. Because at the sounding of the trumpet, the dead will_come_alive and will_be_given a body that can't rot, and we(incl) also who are still alive, our(incl) body(s) will_be_changed/replaced. 53 Because this body that can_rot, needs to be replaced with a body that can't rot. And this body that dies, needs to be replaced with a body that can't die. 54 [xr]If/When the body is replaced with (one that) can't rot, and replaced with (one that) can't die, what_is_written in the Writings is fulfilled that goes, “Death is defeated!”[fn]

55 [xr]“E kamatayen, hendei naan e ka kapanaluwan nu?

55 [xr]“O death, where is your(sg) victory?

E kamatayen, hendei naan e ka lalas nu?”

O death, where is your(sg) venom?”

56 Ka lalas te kamatayen diye egpuun te sale, ne ka geem te sale diye egpuun te Balaud. 57 Piru egpasalamat key te Manama ne iyan egbehey kanta te geem te pegtalu te sale wey te kamatayen pinaahi ki Hisu Kristu!

56 The venom of death comes_from sin, and the power of sin comes from the Law. 57 But we(excl) thank God who gave us(incl) power for overcoming sin and death by_means of Jesus Christ!

58 Purisu me pinalangge ku ne me suled, sasindeg kew ne malig-en wey kene egkaweil. Keilangan ne layun niyu behayi te kabehat ka himu te Magbebaye, su nakanengneng kew e ne due karuan te peglasey-lasey niyu te himu te Magbebaye.

58 Therefore my beloved friends/cousins, stand(pl) strongly and can't be moved. You(pl) need to always give importance (LIT weight) to the work of the Lord, because you(pl) know that there_is value in your(pl) laboring in the work of the Lord.

Ka igbulig para te keet-etawan te Manama

The help for the people of God

161 [xr]Na, meyitenged te igbulig te keet-etawan te Manama: himuwa niyu ke nekey ka impeyimu ku te me punduk te migmalintutuu diye te Galasya. 2 Te an-anayan ne aldew te tagse simana ne iyan ka Duminggu, ka tagse sabeka kaniyu, keilangan ne egtahu iya te seleppi sumale ke pila ka egkaseleppi din. Limura niyu naa sika eyew kene kew e egpangangey te peggenduen ku. 3 Ne emun ke egginguma ad, igpeendiye ku te Hirusalim ka me etew ne naalam niyu ne eg-uyan te igbulig niyu duma te me sulat ku te pegpeila-ila kandan. 4 Ne emun ke eleg iya ne eggendiya a, egmarumeey key e.

161 [xr]Now_then, concerning help for the people of God: do(pl) what_ I _got_ the groups of believers in Galasya _to_do. 2 On the first day of each week which is Sunday, each one of you(pl), needs to put money according to how_much he earns. Collect(pl) that in_order that you(pl) won't be_taking_it on my going_there. 3 And when I arrive, I will_send the people that you(pl) have_chosen to Hirusalim to take your(pl) help along_with my letters to introduce them. 4 And if it's correct that I go_there, we(excl) will_go_together.

Ka planu ni Pablu

The plan of Paul

5 [xr]Egpanumbaley a due te kaniyu te pegkapenga ku diye te Masidunya, su tapey e ne planu ku ne diya a egbaye te Masidunya. 6 Ne kema ke duen e pad iya te kaniyu wey ke taman e buwa te tingmaagsil, su eyew egkabulihan e pad nikaniyu te hipanawan ku ke hendei e ma eggendiye. 7 Su kena a egkeupian ne malepet de ka pegpanumbaley ku kaniyu, ke kene, egkeupian a ne malayat-layat pad ubag, ke igtuhut sika te Magbebaye.

5 [xr]I will_visit you(pl) when I have finished there in Masidunya, because it was already my plan that I pass_ there _through Masidunya. 6 And what if I am still with you(pl) and maybe until the cold_season, so_that I can be_helped by you(pl) for my trip wherever I go. 7 Because I don't want my visiting you(pl) to be just short, but rather, I would like it to be long [embarrassedly], if the Lord permits that.

8 [xr][xr]Piru kuntee, kayi e pad te Ipisu eg-ugpe taman te aldew te Pintikustis 9 su minsan ke masalig ka egkuntere keddiey, masalig ded ka kaayunan ku te peggimu te himu ku ne dakel se karuan.

8 [xr][xr]But now, I will_ still _live here in Ipisu until the day of Pintikustis 9 because even_though many oppose me, there are also many opportunities (LIT (things)_it_is_possible) for doing my work which has_ great _purpose.

10 [xr]Emun ke eggingume e si Timutiyu due te kaniyu, al-alumamaa niyu sikandin eyew kene egkabantalan, tenged su eggimu degma sikandin te himu te Magbebaye iling keddiey. 11 Sikan naa, kene niyu sikandin le-leiha. Ne emun ke eglibed e sikandin kayi te keddiey, bulihi niyu sikandin su eyew egmeupiya ka peggeram-geram din, su egtetaharan ku sikandin duma te me suled ta ne migmalintutuu.

10 [xr]If/When Timutiyu arrives to you(pl), welcome(pl) him so_that (he) won't feel_uncomfortable, because he also does the work of the Lord like me. 11 So then, don't despise/take_advantage of him. And if/when he returns to me, help(pl) him so_that his feelings will_be_good, because I am waiting for him along_with our(incl) friends/cousins who believe.

12 Na, meyitenged te suled ta ne si Apulus, amana ku banasali sikandin ne egpanumbaley kaniyu duma te duma pad man-e ne me suled ta ne migmalintutuu. Piru kene kun pad eggendue sikandin te seini ne timpu, wey kun e egpakigkita sikandin kaniyu ke egpakasellat e sikandin.

12 Now_then, concerning our(incl) friend/cousin Apulus, I greatly encouraged him to visit you(pl) along_with our(incl) other friends/cousins who are believers. But he won't [hearsay] go_there at this time, he will_ only _be_(able_to)_see you(pl) when he has an opportunity.

Ka katammanan ne pegpanaha-taha

The final goodbye

13 Bantey kew, wey heheta niyu ka pegpalintutuu niyu. Pakabbulut kew wey pakannekal kew. 14 Minsan nekey ka eggimuwen niyu, ipapitew niyu ka geyinawa niyu diye te duma.

13 Guard(pl), and tighten(pl) your(pl) believing/faith. Be_bold(pl) and strive(pl). 14 What ever you(pl) do, show(pl) your(pl) love to others.

15 [xr]Me suled, nakataha kew e meyitenged engki Istipanas wey te langun ne diye te baley rin. Sikandan ka an-anayan ne migpalintutuu diye te Akaya, wey migpahamit sikandan eyew te pegbulig te keet-etawan te Manama. 16 Egbanasalan ku sikaniyu ne paruma-ruma kew te iling kandan wey diye te me duma ne maali-ali ne eggimu para te Magbebaye.

15 [xr]Friends/cousins, you(pl) know about Istipanas and all in his house. They were the first who believed in Akaya, and they caused_(themselves)_to_be_used for helping the people of God. 16 I encourage you(pl) to comply(pl) with (those) like them and with others who are industrious at working for the Lord.

17 Nahala a ne miggingume e ensi Istipanas, si Purtunatu, wey si Akaiku. Ne minsan ke ware kew kayi, duen e sikandan ka liwan niyu 18 su ware tapid kanta ne imbagget nikandan. Eleg iya ne eg-ileen ka iling due ne me etew.

17 I am happy that Istipanas, Purtunatu, and Akaiku arrived already. And even if you(pl) are not here, they (are) here to replace you(pl) 18 because they encouraged us(incl) all. It's good (LIT correct) that people like that are recognized.

19 [xr]Egpangemusta kaniyu ka migmalintutuu kayi te prubinsya te Asya. Ne si Akilu wey si Prisila, duma te seeye se egmanimba diye te baley ran, mapahetpet degma ne egpangemusta kaniyu te nasabeke e due te Magbebaye. 20 Egpangemusta degma ka langun ne suled ta kayi.

19 [xr]The believers here in the province of Asya greet you(pl). And Akilu and Prisila, along_with those who worship in their house, also energetically greet you(pl) who are_united in the Lord. 20 All our(incl) friends/cousins here also greet (you).

Pegpangemusteey kew ka tagse sabeka te pegpapitew ne migpaheyinaweey kew.[fn]

Greet_[reciprocally](pl) each one showing that you(pl) love_one_another.[fn]

21 Ne kuntee, sikeddiey e, si Pablu, ka mig-uney-uney ne migsulat te seini ne pegpangemusta.

21 And now, I, Paul, am personally writing this greeting.

22 Ke due ware miggeyinawa te Magbebaye, igdilus sikandin.

22 If there_is (someone) who doesn't love the Lord, he will_be_cursed.

Libed kad, Magbebaye ney!

Return(sg), our(excl) Lord!

23 Ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Magbebaye ne si Hisus, egkaangken niyu.

23 (May) the goodness and mercy of the Lord Jesus, be received by you(pl).

24 Miggeyinawaan ku sikaniyu langun se nasabeke e due ki Kristu Hisus. Malehet iya.

24 I love you(pl) all who are_united in Christ Jesus. True indeed.
